news.title: MTG《黑暗要塞命运奥秘》捆绑包：里面有什么，值这个价吗？
news.summary: MTG Marvel Darkhold Destiny Arcanum Bundle features exclusive alt-art promo cards and booster packs. Here is a

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/magic-the-gathering-marvel-darkhold-destiny-arcanum-bundle-1792165923634.jpg

Preorders are now open for Magic: The Gathering's next Marvel crossover, Darkhold Destiny . Amazon has already listed the Darkhold Destiny Arcanum Bundle for $99.99 , sold directly by the retailer, which is quickly becoming one of the most popular items from the new set.

For comparison, trading card marketplace TCGplayer is asking $200 for the same bundle , meaning Amazon is $100.01 cheaper. On the other hand, you shouldn’t take TCGplayer’s lowest price as the best listing available on the site in the short term, as there are currently only two sellers at this time; we expect more to appear as time goes on.
In the meantime, the Darkhold Destiny Arcanum Bundle has an interesting collection content-wise, and whether it’s worth the price tag or not more or less depends on what you’re looking for.
What's Inside the Darkhold Destiny Arcanum Bundle?
Along with a Collector Booster (alt-art Arcanum promo cards and Full-Art Lands), you’ll also get eight regular Booster Packs inside Darkhold Destiny’s Arcanum Bundle.

If you’re the type of Magic: The Gathering collector who usually likes going after the fancier treatments — like source-material cards, silver foil versions, and Midnight Raised Foils, that’s already a nice extra bang for your hundred bucks.
On the other hand, don’t go into this thinking you’re guaranteed one of the rarest pulls from the get-go, as the headliner Mythic Rares only have a 1% chance of appearing in Collector Boosters.

Personally, I think it’s the promos that will make this one more worth grabbing. You get three altogether: one traditional foil Mythic Rare, and two of six traditional foil promos — the latter being Arcanum cards with alternate art that’s exclusive to the bundle.
The remaining extras are 30 basic lands, including ten full-art Bifrost lands (five foil and five non-foil), an oversized Spindown life counter and a dedicated storage box.
Is it Worth $100?

As for Darkhold Destiny itself, first impressions so far make it seem like it’s a definite Magic: The Gathering worth grabbing if you were of a fan of the earlier Marvel Super Heroes, or you’re simply catching up and want to try new crossovers.

The story behind it is another interesting one, with Dormammu and Hela using a page of the Darkhold to tear through realities and spread ‘arcane nightmares across the multiverse’, as Wizards of the Coast puts it; all standard comic book-esque fun.

As for value in terms of the Darkhold Destiny Arcanum Bundle, however, Amazon also lists the regular nine-pack Bundle for $69.99 , whilst Draft Night costs $119.99 with 12 boosters and a Collector Booster. If you’re more after grabbing as many packs as possible, I’d advise those latter two being your top priority.
The regular Bundle does have its own mechanically unique Mythic Rare promo, though; it’s just not packing alternate-art cards and a Collector Booster like the Arcanum version.
Be that as it may, the Arcanum bundle is totally worth it if you want a good amount of packs and some exclusive foil promos to go with it — pretty much a must-buy for avid Magic collectors.
There are currently no other listings outside of Amazon’s $99.99 and TCGplayer’s $200 listings, though, so we’d advise grabbing the former whilst you can before it sells out if you’re keen.

news.title: “团队的一个非官方目标是被禁止、未分级或受到限制”——《猛鬼追魂：复兴》如何在忠实于克莱夫·巴克的同时拓展修士传说
news.summary: Hellraiser: Revival understands Clive Barker on a much deeper level than just gore and sex — it's a deeply aut

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/hr1-oo-1789670071470.png
Warning: This article contains spoilers for Hellraiser: Revival.

The first five minutes of Hellraiser: Revival will make your eyebrows high-five the ceiling. It opens with a BDSM-flavored sex scene complete with piercing and blood and a veritable buffet of sex toys scattered around the room, then evolves into a gory example of what hooks and chains can do to flesh. If you're sweet and innocent you might want to clutch some pearls, but to Clive Barker fans like me it's a signal that Revival is committing to the spirit of the author and director’s sexy subversion rather than watering it down. And I'm not an easy woman to please. The original Hellraiser movie rewired my brain when I saw it as a teenager (yes, I have a therapist), and Barker's Books of Blood volumes are in my top five reads of all time. I was bracing for disappointment, but that opening proved that Revival wasn't going to shy away from the body horror or sex that runs through Barker's work. The Hellraiser world is one of horrible and hedonistic extremes, so trying to avoid either would be like trying to swap Beyond Meat patties for prime rib. And the deeper I got into Hellraiser: Revival, the clearer it became that the game's understanding of those extremes went beyond pure sex and gore.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/07/hellraiser-ending-blog-1791378852136.jpg

Expanding on any existing fiction, especially one as iconic as the Hellraiser series, is a challenge for anyone. Luckily, developer Saber Interactive was able to work with its creator directly, with Nenad Tomic, Revival’s executive producer, telling Xbox Wire that Barker was "deeply involved with the game from the very beginning" and shaped everything from "visual style and story motifs to the lore and character personalities." From a player experience perspective, it's key that the game stars the OG Pinhead, Doug Bradley, because no one wants a bad impersonator ruining the party.

Some parallels are obvious. Saber Interactive has explicitly said that Revival’s protagonist, Aidan, was inspired by Julia from Barker’s novella The Hellbound Heart and its film adaptation, Hellraiser, and you can see the game playing with the same themes of obsessive attachment, sexual need, and total simp behavior. Julia is willing to act as a honey trap to secure victims for her oozing lover, while Aidan is ready to make a deal with Pinhead and then go on a killing spree to bring back his girl. It's at once beautiful and twisted, and if nothing else a step up from a man who rolls his eyes when you ask him to share his fries. Never settle, ladies.

"Like Julia, Aidan is a character experiencing a fundamental dissatisfaction with life,” Antony De Fault, Hellraiser: Revival’s narrative director, tells me. “His heart yearns for feelings of purpose and vitality, and like Julia, the object of that fixation is a person with an even deeper dissatisfaction, who accelerates his self-destructive tendencies. In Aidan’s case, that’s his girlfriend Sunny.

"The most significant difference between the two is that Julia has suppressed her yearning for a long time, attempting to play the ‘good housewife,' whereas Aidan has pursued it,” De Fault continues. “This history of troublemaking and criminality makes him more worldly, and in particular, more equipped for violence.

"This was a deliberate departure from Julia’s mold, since Aidan is a player character in an FPS horror game. We wanted to give the player a variety of gameplay experiences, which included stealth, exploration, and enemies you can’t directly fight (the experiences of Kirsty in the movies), but also ‘game-y’ experiences like combat challenges and resource management. For those, a more competent character like Aidan made sense."

Throughout Hellraiser: Revival’s story, we get to see flashbacks of Sunny and Aidan’s relationship and better understand how a devotion strong enough to send you into the Labyrinth, the Cenobites’ hellish dimension ruled by Leviathan, develops. The ties that bind you need to be stronger than meeting at a work Christmas party and sharing a love of Netflix reality shows for that sort of errand. Aidan was a drug addict, now Sunny is his fix – she changed his life and he's not sure what trying to go on without her would even look like. We also get a little glimpse at what happens when only one half of a couple is on board with worshipping at the altar of pleasure and pain thanks to a couple called Sean and Charlotte, whose story we learn through letters scattered around the world. Spoiler: It is not a happy ending.
Like a Prayer

As well as ensuring fans get to see all their favorites – Pinhead, Butterball, and my personal nightmare fuel, Chatterer – Hellraiser: Revival makes its own contribution to the lore by diving deeper into the idea of an organized religion, The Scarlet Church, developing around the Cenobites. The films have played with the idea before (check out Hellraiser: Deader), but Revival goes all in on a doctrine, some seriously intense interior decor choices, and a brutal path to ascension. In its teachings, pain is a gift that can be given and received, and even a kindness, though it's not beyond exploiting people when it comes to recruiting new members.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/img-3842-1792166456215.JPG

"In a practical sense, we knew that the player couldn’t fight the Cenobites, and that simply running away from them wasn’t going to support an entire game,” explains De Fault. “So we had good cause to invent some sort of force that would often oppose the player in their stead, while still evoking the Cenobites and feeling like it belonged in the world of Hellraiser.
"From there, the leap to a Cenobite-inspired cult seems pretty logical, especially given the religious themes present in Clive’s work," he says.

The church's congregation is the mutilated faithful, whose hobbies include sticking knives in people and wearing latex. De Fault explains that, like the parallels between Aidan and Julia, the church in some ways represents Frank from the original Hellraiser.
"They’re people who are so dissatisfied with life, so numb to it, that they will go to incredible extremes in their pursuit of intense experiences that make them feel vital,” he says.

"But like Frank, as you’ll discover in the game, the Scarlet Church aren’t actually prepared for the reality of what the Cenobites offer. They seek the Cenobites because they want hedonic pleasure, or power, as opposed to what the Cenobites really are, which is more spiritual (“Explorers, in the further regions of experience”). The only one who really ‘gets it’ is their misunderstood Prophet, Bruno."

Another key player in the cult is an unhinged doctor called Colin Marlowe, who shares an approach to elective surgery that would make even Beverly Hills trophy wives think, "Now steady on." And then there's Charlotte, who gives an insight into why someone might follow the teachings of the church, writing things like, "There is divinity in my wretchedness, splendor in every ugly part of me," and "For the first time in my life, I feel accepted and understood. I can be myself... my true self... the Scarlet Church gave me that truth.” For her, submitting to the church represents acceptance, identity, and a way to see the parts of herself she despises as sacred rather than shameful.

news.title: Switch 2 上的《现代战争 4》并不是你想象的灾难
news.summary: Modern Warfare 4 is the first Call of Duty since 2013 to launch on a Nintendo console. We played the campaign

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/mw4-switch-blog-1792059802695.jpg

Not since 2013’s Call of Duty: Ghosts launched on the Wii U has a mainline COD game appeared on a Nintendo console. 2026’s Modern Warfare 4 is breaking that 14-year dry spell by releasing on Switch 2, and I got to play a couple of missions from the campaign to see how it fares. I won’t lie, my expectations were low – Call of Duty is always on the cutting edge of graphics and performance, and Nintendo’s latest isn’t intentionally built for that. And yet, I came away pleasantly surprised by what Digital Legends, the Activision studio dedicated to this version of MW4, has achieved from a technical standpoint.

For my full review of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , I played on PC, which provided a useful benchmark for what the most ideal version of the game looks like. Of course, when placed side-by-side with the Switch 2 version, you’ll immediately notice the difference — it looks stunning on PC and runs like a dream, as you’d expect. But, shifting over to Switch 2 didn’t offend my eyes quite like I feared it would. Granted, the textures are nowhere near as detailed, with flat surfaces and faces smoothed over to give the impression of plasticine versions of the campaign’s characters. It's by no means a looker, but considering the reduced horsepower Nintendo’s latest console is working with, the gameplay itself was smooth, running at 30fps at 4K while docked. The campaign is locked at 30, while multiplayer will target 60.

That campaign framerate remained consistent, too, not even hitching or stuttering during some of the story’s most explosive moments — I deliberately made sure to capture part of a mission that showcases one of its most hectic sequences to test it out. You can check that gameplay out for yourself in the video above, but I was left impressed that a game which normally demands so much of the hardware it is being played on performed so well on the Switch 2. Yes, it's quite a visual downgrade when compared to the likes of PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X, but that comes with the territory. And if you’re solely a Nintendo owner who’s been locked out of Call of Duty for over a decade, you’re getting a version of Modern Warfare 4 that feels every bit as snappy as the series usually is, even if it’s a bit muddier than Nintendo’s own crisp visuals.

news.title: 滑稽的新游戏让我对即将推出的战术游戏更加兴奋
news.summary: I was already looking forward to upcoming tactics game Australia Did It , but now I've got another reason to d

content.v: I was already looking forward to upcoming tactics game Australia Did It , but now I've got another reason to do so: a hilariously expanded new name.

In a fun turn of events, designer Rami Ismail has revealed a new subtitle has officially been adopted. Back in August, he posted a suggestion about the name that had been made as part of a localization report that turned out to be incredible.

"One localisation report for Australia Did It returned with a note that the game's title won't work in their territory & suggested to instead use 'Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defence Business' and now I want that, like, globally," he wrote at the time.

He subsequently asked fans to express their support for the name, in the hopes he could use it to convince publisher Mystic Forge to actually adopt the subtitle. And with this week's announcement of a release date, the news was confirmed, and the game will officially be called Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business.

The original, subtitle-less name was certainly memorable. Despite a sea of games coming out at all times that seek to push everything more than five seconds old out of my brain, it was the rare game whose name actually stuck in my head since it first caught my eye last year. That said, there is something about the combination of proper hyphenation and the almost-sarcastic precision of this new subtitle that I just love.

Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business (sorry, I just wanted to write it again) releases on Steam on November 10. A demo is still available, and I highly recommend it--the game has a fun blend of genres going on. To simply call it a roguelite tactics game sells it short from what I've played. Half of the game sees you defending a base in the style of tower defense, while the other has you managing units who defend your train once it finally gets on the move. What I enjoyed most, though, is a fun system that lets you combine distinct units in order to create new ones that blend their abilities together. (There's a great dash of manipulating enemy and unit positioning, too, which I'm always a sucker for.)
We'll see next month if the quality of the demo can sustain itself in the long haul, but whatever the case, at least it'll do so with a kickass name.

news.title: “我们搞砸了”——《战狗》老板承认第二季进展得不太好
news.summary: Wardogs developer Bulkhead had some strong words to say about the rough launch of Season 2, admitting: "We f**

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/10/wardogsthumb-1789046591629.png
Wardogs developer Bulkhead had some strong words to say about the rough launch of Season 2, admitting: "We f***ed up."
Season 2 saw the introduction of XP and cash bonuses for people willing to play Blue Team, in an attempt to polish Lonestar’s tarnished reputation .

Unfortunately, the idea backfired as more experienced players quickly boosted their accounts on Blue. Usually it takes a while for players to unlock some of the deadliest gear, but the XP and cash boosts saw players quickly kitted out in the best armor and the most annoying weapons.
"We were wrong, we f***ed up," Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer said. "This was an experiment — we thought we'd have this in for about a week.” The boosts have already been removed in a hotfix.

The cash and XP bonuses saw Blue Team go from the worst performing team to quickly dominating every match, attracting all the best players. The bonuses were 5% extra cash and 2.5% extra XP, but it was enough to attract the most try-hard players in the game.

"The only comment that annoyed me is when people say, 'They didn't address the core issues [with Blue Team]," Brammer continued, talking about team spawn placement. "Well, actually, we did rebalance the entire spawn setup for Bakurani, and we did test that out quite a lot and see that the difference had balanced out.
“We should have just stuck to our guns with that, really, but here we are — we tried, it didn't work, this is us holding our hands up."

Wardogs is still in Early Access so these kinds of teething issues are to be expected as the devs experiment and find the right balance for the 1.0 release. The game exploded in terms of sales, and the developers have been scrambling to keep up with its popularity since.

Bulkhead also had to contend with making sure Wardogs works on consoles, where the game will eventually land in 1.0. The developer already admitted to having to hold back Wardogs features to make sure it’ll run on Xbox Series S .
Wardogs Season 2 also introduced a new rain system that impacts gameplay. Players have to really cock their heads to pick up footsteps, and visibility for pilots is drastically reduced.

news.title: 《使命召唤：MW4》活动今日启动，请勿剧透
news.summary: It's a big day for Call of Duty, as Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable beginning today, Oct

content.v: It's a big day for Call of Duty, as Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable beginning today, October 16, for people who preorder the game.
The campaign is available to preload now, but doesn't unlock until 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET. You can play early across PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.

Developer Infinity Ward issued a statement, asking people to please not spoil the story. "We've one one ask. Let everyone experience it for themselves. Keep the campaign spoilers under wraps," Infinity Ward said. "Time to go dark."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/mw4campaign-Large-1.jpeg?w=636

MW4 is expected to wrap up the current Modern Warfare storyline that began with 2019's Modern Warfare. Activision boss Tyler Bahl told The Game Business that MW4 is the "epic conclusion of the recent series of Modern Warfare."

"It’s not that some characters and pieces can’t live on beyond this and be reinvented. But we’re excited by closing this chapter and launching a new one," he said. "Where we go with future games, we have to innovate."
To that end, Bahl also confirmed that a new sub-franchise for Call of Duty is in the works after years of Modern Warfare and Black Ops games.

MW4 officially launches on October 23, but the early access doesn't end with campaign, as the new version of DMZ unlocks on October 20 for people who preordered the game . Multiplayer won't be available until October 23.

news.title: 《黎明行者之血》的下一个更新将让你消除错误并抚摸狗
news.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is already one of the best role-playing games of the year, but developer Rebel Wolves

content.v: The Blood of Dawnwalker is already one of the best role-playing games of the year, but developer Rebel Wolves is preparing a big update that should make it even better. Like all good things in life, it starts with getting to pet a dog.

Update 1.1, which is scheduled to arrive next week, brings a number of new features to the game, including the ability to pet both dogs and cats via the game's directional system, which is currently only used for combat. It will also feature a new Story difficulty setting that provides "additional combat assist," new subtitle settings across all lines of dialogue, and most crucially, an item called Draught of Mind Rebirth.

The Draught of Mind Rebirth will allow you to forget all the skills and abilities you've acquired across the Swordmastery, Witchcraft, and Vampirism trees. Not only will this give you the chance to reallocate your points in a way that best fits your playstyle--it will also give you back the time associated with those skills. That means you'll have the chance to complete extra missions if you happen to find yourself impeded with Dawnwalker's 30-day limit. However, we don't find the system to be restrictive as it currently stands.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/image_758cbb.jpeg?w=636

Alongside the new features, Update 1.1. will also feature some tweaks to existing systems. These include an update to the FrameGen system, improvements to the camera, better Shadowstep and Planeshift abilities, and the removal of censorship of blood in the Japanese version. It will also include combat improvements that should make it easier to correctly target your enemy of choice--currently, it's a little finicky because of the direction-based system which prioritizes you blocking incoming attacks--regardless of who's trying to strike you--over you focusing in on a particular enemy.

The Blood of Dawnwalker is out now on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. In our review , Phil Hornshaw said, "The Blood of Dawnwalker is the kind of RPG that feels great to get lost in, that digs into your mind and stays there, and which is worth scouring and savoring."

news.title: Bank 表示，《Red Dead》将于 2027 年或 2028 年推出“可能并非不合理”，但事实确实如此
news.summary: Citi, the investment bank and financial services company, has released a note about GTA 6 and Rockstar, and in

content.v: Citi, the investment bank and financial services company, has released a note about GTA 6 and Rockstar, and included in the brief is a line about what Rockstar could release next--a new Red Dead game.

The company said in its memo that, if Rockstar is telling the truth that GTA 6 did not in fact cost $1.5 billion to make , then the studio may be able to get a new Red Dead game out sooner than anyone might have imagined.
Citi said a new Red Dead game releasing in 2027 or 2028 "may not be unreasonable," according to Yahoo Finance .
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/RDR2-Large-1.jpeg?w=636
The bank might be saying this, but it would be incredibly shocking, for a number of reasons, if a new Red Dead game releases as soon as next year.

There are historically years between major Rockstar releases, and even longer gaps between entries in the same series. For example, Red Dead Redemption launched in 2010, followed by GTA 5 in 2013, then Red Dead Redemption II in 2018, and now GTA 6 in 2026.

Another notable element to consider is how Rockstar makes games today. The company tried to develop GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption II concurrently, and if it was able to pull it off, Rockstar claimed it would have been able to release GTA 6 years earlier . However, Rockstar deemed this too ambitious, with studio head Rob Nelson opting to reassign staff from GTA 6 to Red Dead Redemption II to help get it out the door.
At one point in time, developed multiple games concurrently across offices, but now, Rockstar’s network of teams work on one project together before moving on to the next.

GTA 6 may be coming out soon, but Rockstar no doubt has committed extensive resources to post-launch support, and that's not even mentioning the next evolution of GTA Online . Although Rockstar has announced no plans for online support whatsoever for GTA 6, it's expected that GTA 6 will have some kind of extensive online experience that is supported for years to come.

At the same time, a company like Rockstar is no doubt planning for the future already, and a new Red Dead game would seem like an extremely safe bet. After all, Red Dead Redemption II has sold a breathtaking 87 million copies, making it one of the best-selling games of all time .
Faster development

While Rockstar getting a new Red Dead out in 2027 or 2028 might be extremely ambitious and wishful thinking on the part of Citi, Rockstar and parent company Take-Two have indicated that new structures are in place to help make games faster.
CEO Strauss Zelnick told The Game Business that people should not "confuse long development cycles with a lackadaisical approach to development cycles."

Some games are "so complex and so challenging to build" that they simply take a long time to make. However, Zelnick said "recent development in technology" may be able to help Take-Two's studio's "compress some development timelines without compromising quality."

Zelnick may be referring to Take-Two's embrace of AI here , but it's unclear. Rockstar's Phil Hooker, meanwhile, said the company's hiring spree and updates to its technology stack should help Rockstar make games faster in the future .

Something else to consider here is that Zelnick and Hooker might be talking more to analysts and investors with their comments about making games faster. Only time will tell if it's actually another eight years before Rockstar releases another game after GTA 6; for now, it's just talk.

news.title: 《黎明行者之血》更新 1.1 添加了定向动物抚摸以及超过 1,100 项其他改进和修复
news.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker update 1.1 adds directional animal petting and over 1,100 other improvements and fixes

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/18/dawnwalker-brencis-blogroll-1789733324205.jpg

Rebel Wolves really put out something special with The Blood of Dawnwalker , its vampire RPG where you straddle the line between monster and man. Now it’s getting even better with directional animal petting. Yeah, you heard.

Similar to Kingdom Come: Deliverance, Dawnwalker’s combat uses directional inputs to attack and defend from different angles during combat. Update 1.1, due out next week, will let you take that system and use it to frantically rub a dog.
“What happens when you merge a directional combat system with the ability to pet dogs and cats?” the studio asked . “Directional. Animal. Petting.”
The update also adds a consumable item: the Draught of Mind Rebirth. Take a sip and you’ll be able to respec all your upgrade points and try out a different build without starting the game again.

Elsewhere, the game is also getting an even easier mode for those who couldn’t get to grips with directional combat, as well as options for larger font sizes for the subtitles. Accessibility is always good.

There are also some visual upgrades coming, such as frame generation improvements, better animations and camera movement, improved lock-on and targeting, and better traversal. The Japanese version of the game has had all the blood and gore put back in, which is kinda vital for a game about a clan of human-sized leeches.

Rebel Wolves said there are over 1,100 other improvements in The Blood of Dawnwalker’ update 1.1. That’s a lot, and suggests a certain level of dedication. It shouldn't be a huge surprise though — the former The Witcher developers see the game as a starting point for an epic RPG series.

The Dawnwalker team has already teased where that future might take the series one day, with a CGI trailer depicting lead character Coen in the present day . The advantages of being an immortal halfbreed, eh? The Blood of Dawnwalker passed 1 million copies sold in its first two days, which suggests the team will at least get another game out. Whether that takes Coen straight to the present day or flips forward to another historical pinch point like Assassin’s Creed remains to be seen.

news.title: 一个推箱子游戏烧了1.8亿 做了10年！好玩在哪？

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906641.jpg
题图 | 《沉星之序》
作者 | 祈雨
上周 （10月9日） ，《沉星之序》终于上线了。
这款产品是市面上最受瞩目的独立游戏之一，主创Jonathan Blow （代表作《时空幻境》《见证者》，国内一般称之为吹哥） 是独立游戏领域赫赫有名的开发者，而《沉星之序》则是他自2016年 《见证者》 （《The Witness》） 之后的新作，研发时间长达十年。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906645.jpg
先前在新品节释出demo时，《见证者》还特地发了个「终于，在十年之后……」的公告
而这款游戏或许也是历史上成本最贵的独立游戏，可能没有之一。
在年初的播客中， Jonathan Blow 算了一笔帐，过去10年里公司资金的消耗速度是每年180万美元-440万美元之间，折中一下，每年大概花掉300万美元，九年时间已经花掉了2700万美元（折合人民币约1.8亿元）。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906642.jpg
博客的部分翻译
据研究机构HushCrasher数据，80%Steam游戏的开发成本都低于100万美元，而《沉星之序》的研发成本已经能和许多 2A游戏 （数百万美元预算级别）所媲美了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906643.jpg
图源：HushCrasher
但或许是受到解谜品类的限制，《沉星之序》的销量在第一时间并没有大爆。截至发稿时间，《沉星之序》的 销量在9.5万套（ 据VG Insight数据 ）左右， 在Steam上收获了 1992篇评测，好评率为97%。SteamDB数据显示，游戏最高同时在线人数为8247人， 这一成绩已经超越了当初《见证者》的6185人。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906644.jpg
如果要硬论玩法，其实简单用一句话就可以介绍完，即 开放世界推箱子游戏 。在某次采访中，Jonathan Blow提到《沉星之序》的解谜体量在500个小时左右，谜题数量已经突破1000个。换句话说，《沉星之序》应该是历史以来最大的推箱子/解谜游戏了。
游戏新知体验了接近30个小时，游戏体验在「我是天才」和「我是「文明用语」」之间反复横跳，游戏最有趣的体验是，每解开一处谜题，后续就会触发更有趣的交互机制，就像在慢慢织出一张巨大的网，反倒是玩得越久越有乐趣的类型。
用类似乘法的思路来构建谜题
落实到游戏之中，《沉星之序》的灵感原型来源于四款明确的免费游戏，并将其分为了东西南北四大区域，即Alan Hazelden的《Skipping Stones to Lonely Homes》（南部区域）和《 Mirror Isles 》（东部区域）Jonah Ostroff的《Heroes of Sokoban》（北部区域）、Sean Barrett的《Promesst》（西部区域）。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906646.jpg
四款看起来都很粗糙的原型游戏
很有意思的是，这四大区域选择了一种类似乘法的交互设计思路，先前所学习到的机制总是会在后面的谜题中发挥作用，
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906647.jpg
《沉星之序》的部分地图
这四大区域均拥有自己的特点。以东部区域的「镜之群岛」作为案例，在游戏新知所体验的部分中， 这个谜题几乎只有一种核心机制，即镜面反射 ， 玩家可以通过镜子传送到反射的位置，并成功抵达目的地。但通过对各种细节的改变，这种看似简单的机制也就被玩出花来。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906648.gif
东部区域的第一个谜题
最开始，玩家只需要移动自身找准传送的位置，最终抵达目的地。后续谜题则开始增加变量，根据已有的特性衍生出不同的谜题。比如说增加镜子数量、增加可以推出海中的垫脚石头、增加可以利用镜子传送的石头、增加可操控的角色等等。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906651.gif
增加镜子数量
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906650.gif
可以被镜子传送的石头
而镜子之间还可以产生联动，比如说靠两面镜子可以折射出特殊的角度，而当玩家同时站在两面镜子前，就可以制造出另一个自己。另外，《沉星之序》还增加了仅能反射一面的单面镜，通过不断加入多种变量，这种机制的乐趣就开始一点一点铺开，谜题愈加复杂，但乐趣也越来越足。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906649.gif
制造出多个分身
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_4892634_4906654.gif
只能单面反射的镜子
如果说东部区域是 通过挖掘单一机制来构建谜题的乐趣，而北部区域则更强调多类机制的协同 ，并为此设计了多种具备不同功能的奇幻类型职业，且非常容易理解。
以「搬运英雄」为例，比如说战士力量高，所以能推得动多个物体；
盗贼喜欢背着东西跑路，所以能拖拽背后的物体；
法师则可以施展法术，能和对面的物体交换位置；
起初的关卡往往只是单个职业进行解谜，往后则会进行两类、三类职业合作的谜题，玩家需要合理发挥每位角色的功能，才能够顺利通关。
两类职业合作谜题
三类职业合作谜题
而进度越往下推进，职业数量和功能也会继续增多，如牧师可以保护自己和同伴免受怪物伤害，而德鲁伊则可以将物体变成晶石，吟游诗人则可以让周围的生物跟随自己移动，这些角色彼此之间互相搭配，也就诞生出了更多种组合谜题。
牧师和德鲁伊的合作谜题
吟游诗人可以硬控其他生物
西部区域同样是多类机制结合的地图，玩家在地图中收集宝石，宝石可以触发有特殊功能的光束， 但这一区域的特点在于，玩家要主动思考开启光束的时机，也要思索光束之间如何进行搭配 ， 以「光束发射器之库」为案例，光束的功能如下：
放入宝石来触发光束
红色光束可以用来开启特定的门；
绿色光束可以让玩家在地形之间穿越；
蓝色光束可以让玩家推动物体；
黄色光束可以让玩家击碎障碍物；
橙色光束可以让玩家一次性跳跃2格距离；
这些光束之间同样讲究配合，如第一关中收集宝石时就要利用橙色光束进入小空间，而后利用黄色光束击碎障碍物，同样有两种、三种光束配合才能完成的谜题。
围绕这些光束的机制，《沉星之序》在这一区域还放入了多种搭配的特殊道具，如可以推动面前物体的「雪花石膏短杖」，以及可以改变光束方向的道具「有机玻璃项环」。
「雪花石膏短杖」可以用来推动发出光束的机器
「有机玻璃项环」改变光束发射的方向
更有意思的是，东方和北方区域多数是以单个关卡的形式来呈现的，而西方区域的关卡类型往往比较大，这也就更考验玩家对于光束机制的理解。

news.title: 这款动漫追踪者俄罗斯轮盘游戏担心 AI 模仿者会窃取其创意
news.summary: Developers have dealt with copycat games for many years, but generative AI has made it easier than ever to whi

content.v: Developers have dealt with copycat games for many years, but generative AI has made it easier than ever to whip up a clone, and that problem has grown in recent years. The developer behind Drunken Goddess Reflux is aware of this, and out of fear that its anime Russian roulette game could be the victim of a cash-grab imitation, it has announced that it has canceled its upcoming public demo. Instead, Alliance Arts will hold closed online play sessions for a limited number of players.

"We sincerely apologize for the short notice to everyone who was looking forward to it," the developer wrote online . "We're concerned that the demo's content could be used to quickly imitate or replicate the game's presentation and gameplay with AI or other tools, and that such works could be released before our launch."

Alliance Arts is also concerned that it can't properly manage restrictions on posting and streaming content from the game, and it'll instead hand out demo keys and collect feedback for the game through its group Discord. The studio's fears aren't unwarranted, with the upcoming Needle in a Haystack being a prime example of Steam's copycat problem. After the game was announced in August and a clip of its purposefully tedious gameplay went viral--you genuinely are just looking for a needle in a haystack--clones quickly popped up online.
A quick search on Steam reveals several games all with a similar theme, and these have been released within weeks of each other.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Needle-in-a-haystack-games.jpg?w=636

What happened here? AI-assisted games have been popping up more and more lately on Steam, and while you'll seldom find disclosure text indicating that agents like Claude and ChatGPT have been used in their development, the fast turnaround, near-identical gameplay, and artwork with a telltale yellow filter suggest that the tech played a heavy hand in quickly whipping up a clone.

With Claude 5.5 making it easier than ever to decompile a game into code that's playable within a browser, Alliance Arts might be justified in wanting to keep the game within a tight-knit circle of players. It's not unfeasible to imagine a bad actor using the code for the demo to generate a carbon copy and put that up for sale on Steam.
Hit multiplayer game Meccha Chameleon also has its fair share of copycats, as shortly after release, a wave of new games copied its hide-and-seek-with-bad-art formula.

The Drunken Goddess Reflux demo cancellation comes shortly before the start of Steam Next Fest this month, but with the event having become a dumping ground for demos, it could have been buried under thousands of other games vying for player attention. It's currently one of the top 100 most-wishlisted games on Steam, so there's plenty of interest.

In case you missed it when it was first revealed several months ago, Drunken Goddess Reflux combines alcohol with a demonic Tsundere anime lady and the deadly game of Russian roulette. It's a game of shots and shots, as the drunker you get, the better your odds are of not receiving a lead headache. The game officially launches on December 8 for PC.

news.title: 在微软不再是 BDS 抵制目标之前，《Big Walk》不会登陆 Xbox
news.summary: Big Walk has been a critical hit since it launched a few months ago on PC and PS5, but one major platform wher

content.v: Big Walk has been a critical hit since it launched a few months ago on PC and PS5, but one major platform where you won't find it is Xbox Series X|S. That's no accident: Developer House House said its decision not to release the game on Xbox was a show of support for the Palestinian-led Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement.

"It has always been our intention for Big Walk to be played by groups of friends, and we know that keeping the game off Xbox runs counter to those intentions," House House wrote in a statement. "This decision means that some people will miss out on playing Big Walk with their friends, and we understand the disappointment we’re causing. We are disappointed too. We would love for people to be able to play the game on Xbox, but not until Microsoft and/or Xbox have been removed as BDS boycott targets. We’ve made this decision with the belief that meaningful change can be made in the world, that coordinated collective action can confront even the most powerful interests, and that one day, Palestine will be free."

Microsoft became a priority target of the BDS initiative due to the contracts it had with the Israeli government and military. BDS has called for a boycott of the company, and by extension, all Xbox games, hardware, and subscriptions.

In response to the announcement by House House, The Palestinian BDS movement wrote in a statement (via People Makes Games' Chris Bratt ) that it "wholeheartedly" supports the developers decision and that it encourages "gamers, game developers, games journalists, and workers" to sign the No Games for Genocide pledge and continue to boycott Xbox.

That pressure on Microsoft has had results, as last year, the company did block the Israeli government from accessing its cloud storage and AI systems, which has reportedly been used to surveil Palestinians in both the West Bank and Gaza.

While some people have asked why Big Walk is available on PCs running a Windows operating system, it is worth noting that purchasing it through a marketplace like Steam does not mean that Microsoft gets a cut of sales from the game, compared to how it would if the game was sold through its Xbox marketplace.

news.title: 前 PlayStation 高管表示，取消 PS5 光盘是有道理的，即使这会激怒人们
news.summary: Ken Kutaragi, the former PlayStation executive known colloquially as the "Father of PlayStation," has reacted

content.v: Ken Kutaragi, the former PlayStation executive known colloquially as the "Father of PlayStation," has reacted to the ongoing debate and discussion about physical games in the wake of Sony's announcement that it will end support for PS5 game discs in 2028.

Speaking to VGC , Kutaragi said he understands that people think they "own" games when they buy them physically. However, he said, "Nobody thinks [physical media] is necessary for a networked device like a smartphone, for example, because people feel that they will keep their content."

He went on to say that he "really" does understand why some people are upset about PlayStation's decision to end discs. After all, Sony continues to sell millions and millions of physical games annually , and in some regions, sales of new games on PS5 are more than 50% physical .
However, as many others have said and data shows, consumers are increasingly leaning toward digital, and that trend is only expected to continue.
"I don’t think it’s economically reasonable [to continue to support discs]. Maybe it’s a mentality issue," he said.

For its part, Sony said ending support for physical discs is a "natural direction" for the company as it adapts to consumer trends. One expert believes Sony killing discs is really about profitability and control .

Kutaragi went on to say he understands that PlayStation's teams now include people who came from "outside," including people from streaming companies through Sony's buyout of streaming service Gaikai . As such, he thinks it only makes sense that these new hires might see PlayStation as "not just a game console, but also a content terminal."
"Maybe that’s how those people are thinking. But this has caused some friction with game enthusiasts," he said.

While Sony might be giving up on physical games, Nintendo doesn't plan to do that, at least not yet . Microsoft has not specified its plans for discs going forward, but most expect Xbox to kill off discs as well .

news.title: 《GTA 6》在官方的反对下接管了迈阿密：“我们将迈阿密描绘成谋杀之都”
news.summary: GTA 6's takeover of real-life Miami is continuing, and in a big way, ahead of the open-world crime game's rele

content.v: GTA 6's takeover of real-life Miami is continuing, and in a big way, ahead of the open-world crime game's release in November. For anyone unaware, GTA 6 takes place in Vice City, which is a stand-in for Miami, and the game also takes players to surrounding areas of its version of Florida, known as Leonida.

After the GTA 6 logo was airlifted onto Miami's Kaseya Earlier this month to promote the game and an upcoming Miami Heat x GTA 6 crossover , Rockstar's marketing efforts have now grown substantially. This has included a number of real-life marketing activations in the Miami area covering real cars, blimps, beach chairs, and more.

The efforts have not been without controversy. Multiple Miami-Dade County commissioners expressed serious concerns about the city taking Rockstar's money to promote a game about violence and murder, among other ... vices.

"We're depicting Miami like a murder capital," Commissioner René Garcia said, according to the Miami Herald. Commissioner Micky Steinberg added: "Philosophically, I feel we should not be moving forward."

Miami-Dade County Mayor Daniella Levine Cava and her office is hoping to bring in millions from its partnership with Rockstar to promote GTA 6 in Miami. Her chief of staff, Chris Hudtwalcker, said the GTA 6 takeovers in Miami are a "love letter" to the city.
Another lawmaker, chairman Anthony Rodriguez, said commissioners should remember GTA 6 is a work of fiction. "We are all adults in this community. We recognize it's just a game," he said.

"We cut our nose to spite our face," said Chair Anthony Rodriguez, who sponsored the legislation authorizing the negotiations. He urged commissioners not to go overboard on concern for made-up plot lines and digital characters. "This is a fictional game. We are all adults in this community. … We recognize it's just a game."

People in Miami have reported seeing GTA-style cars on the city streets, along with a massive Vice City blimp soaring overhead. What's more, branded beach chairs and umbrellas are being dispatched to beaches in south Florida to market GTA 6. The marketing efforts for GTA 6 go beyond Miami, of course, as people have begun to spot big ads in other major American cities like Chicago and New York.

The Miami-Dade County mayor is apparently allowed to negotiate deals under $1 million without the approval of the local commission--this is why the $975,000 Kaseya Center project went ahead without pushback.
Levine Cava is looking to make more deals with Rockstar to promote GTA 6 at the city's airports and ship ports, along with various other places, but it remains to be seen if those will be approved.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S--for more, check out the newly released launch trailer, which features some steamy scenes.

news.title: 我从未玩过时之笛，但重制版的 2 小时证明了这部杰作不仅仅是怀旧
news.summary: I never played Ocarina of Time, but 2 hours with the remake proves there’s so much more to this masterpiece th

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/zelda-idiot-blog-1791975529028.jpg

No matter how much I wish it were the case, I’ll never know what it was like to have seen Jaws in the summer of 1975. Yet, I still get the joy of watching the film that changed blockbuster cinema forever 50 years later, whether that be on towering IMAX screens or wonderfully restored 4K blu-rays. The experience of being there when a film, game, or piece of music entered our culture and witnessing its impact firsthand can never be replicated, but through preservation, remasters, and remakes, new audiences get to uncover these treasures for themselves.

This is the case with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. My recent playtime with a demo of the Switch 2 remake felt like digital archaeology; the unearthing of a cultural artefact that informed so much of what came after it, while remaining a gleaming treasure in its own right. A link between one era of video games and another. A sacred text. At least, that’s how it felt to me. You see, I’ve never played the original.

Well, that’s a tiny bit of a lie — I did briefly mess around in the opening hour or so of the 3DS port around a decade ago. I know, I should be subject to whatever form of medieval torture you deem appropriate. But the truth is, it’s one that simply passed me by, despite having played several Zeldas since — Tears of the Kingdom is a masterwork of open-world design in my eyes, even if Wind Waker still sits closest to my heart. I never owned a Nintendo 64, and likely got distracted by whatever was happening in my mid-20s, which made me put down Ocarina’s portable version. But now, finally, I’m ready to right my wrongs, and after playing two hours of the remake, I couldn’t be more excited to do so.

During my time with the 2026 version of Link’s most defining adventure, I got to play through Kokiri Forest, wander around Castle Town, and complete the Forest Temple. Even from this small sample size, I could see flashes of some of my favourite games within it, and the inspirational sparks it must have fired off into other game developers' minds in 1998. But most importantly, I had a ridiculously fun time with it. From just that short session, I can safely assure you that, if you’re like me and have also somehow let this piece of history slip through your fingers, there’s plenty here for newcomers to enjoy. When it launches in November, there will be little excuse to leave it unplayed.

“Anyone who makes 3D games who says they’ve not borrowed something from Mario or Zelda is lying — from the games on Nintendo 64, not necessarily the ones from today,” said Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser to the New York Times . It’s a point that’s hard to argue with, and one I wouldn’t dare contest — I think one of the minds behind GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 probably knows more about game design than I.

Nintendo having created something of a lending library for game design is something I could see most clearly in the Forest Temple. I enjoyed unpicking each of its knotted series of corridors and unpacking its hidden secrets, all wrapped in a spooky mansion setting. Every room is a puzzle, whether in the more traditional sense of moving heavy stone cubes around to unblock routes or navigating combat challenges that put your tool belt to the test.

Battles are never overly challenging but wonderfully engaging, with looming sword-and-shield-wielding skeletons reacting to your actions as you, in turn, have to counter theirs with a well-timed dodge or stun. When striking them down, you can see the basic structure that would go on to influence Batman Arkham’s brawls — one of the defining melee combat systems — in the way that fights carry the rhythm of enemies reading your movements and you, in turn, having to react with the correct rock-paper-scissors response.

Outside of scraps, the structure of the whole temple can’t help but conjure memories of Dark Souls' intertwining, shortcut-unlocking approach to level design. Every route loops back to its central chamber, in which four coloured flames need to be lit in order for the path to the boss to reveal itself. The construction of this area is masterfully done, clearly indicating what you have to achieve without ever holding your hand too much. That freedom of thought has always been prevalent in Zelda, all the way up to how Tears of the Kingdom brings out your most experimental thoughts with its building systems.

In Ocarina, breadcrumbs of clues as to how to achieve objectives are given, with tempting buttons placed out of reach behind locked gates and high up ledges seemingly unreachable. That’s until you realise you can rotate the hallways and alter the architecture of the temple completely, like some sort of prototype of Dishonored 2’s Clockwork Mansion. This mechanic is key to navigating the space, and where much of its challenge lies. Entire projects, such as Fez, have gone on to use a system like this to power a whole game. Here, it’s utilised for less than an hour. It’s a testament to the enduring inventiveness of Nintendo that these ideas still echo through gaming today.

I found great joy in the simplicity of the temple, but one that tickled my brain enough to never seem like child’s play. There’s a delicate balance when it comes to signposting without holding your hand, to the point where the temple delivered several “aha” moments over the course of my time exploring it. Some came naturally through decades of playing video games, like seeing a frozen target with a raging fire nearby, clearly indicating I needed to fire an arrow through the flames to melt it. But some did give me pause for thought, such as not realising I needed to use my bow to knock each of the temple’s four guardian sprites out of paintings in order to progress. Still, I tried it anyway, and lo and behold, it worked. It’s that sort of “let's see if this works” experimentation that I’ve always appreciated in Zelda, so it’s no surprise to see it pioneered here in the series first foray into 3D.

I was pleasantly surprised to see that the temple’s boss, Phantom Ganon, was also a puzzle, instead of a toe-to-toe fight. Some of my favourite bosses in all of gaming are enigmas to be solved rather than tests of reflexes, whether that be any of Shadow of the Colossus’ beasts or, perhaps more analogously here, Elden Ring’s Rennala. Brain over brawn is clearly Link’s preference too, with well-timed parries key to bringing down this foe once you work out which of the ones charging on horseback out of the paintings that surround you is real.

One of the more notable changes this remake introduces is a jump button. Link was grounded in the original Ocarina of Time, only able to hop over specific gaps dictated by his creators. It was a decision intended to create contrast between Nintendo’s two big series. “You had to press a button to jump when we first started making The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time,” explained Yoshiaki Koizumi, a designer on the original game and Nintendo’s current Senior Executive Officer and Direct host, in an Iwata Asks . “As we were making Super Mario 64, we were thinking about The Legend of Zelda the whole time, and started talking about decreasing the action element in The Legend of Zelda and increasing the puzzle elements.”

content.v: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快”。
本周出场人物：四十二，柏亚舟，白广大
四十二：推荐游戏的谱系学方法
我会通过一个新的方式推荐一批游戏。
首先我想到了一个游戏，《地牢围攻》。我非常非常喜欢这个系列的前两部，虽然回头看小时候我可能没有玩明白这游戏。
https://image.gcores.com/5a65c7bf5d0b49c7812521335f45728f-590-472.png
从现在这个角度来看，《地牢围攻》的特点可以粗暴地归纳为“暗黑2（非常舒适的点击式即时ARPG战斗）”+“小队制BUILD”（小队里的每个人物都可以当做主要人物一样订制）。很好玩，现在回忆起来都很好玩

地牢围攻1和2的制作团队叫Gas Powered Games，创始人叫Chris Taylor，这个人就很有意思了。1996他在Cavedog Entertainment这个团队做了一个游戏，叫《横扫千军 Total Annihilation》，也就是所谓的“TA系 RTS”的鼻祖，是超大——注意嗷，是超极大战场规模RTS的鼻祖。事实上，在所谓的RTS式微的时代，TA系RTS在Steam都不少。在这里我推荐《Zero-K》，是一个Steam上的完全免费游戏，几乎是TA系设计的集大成作品。
Chris Taylor还做过几个游戏，是我童年游戏经历的重要部分。其中一个是《最高指挥官》，时至今日“最指”系列依然是TA系RTS的最高峰之一，这可能是因为它有一个还不短的战役，而后来的很多TA系RTS都不做正经战役了。
其次他还做了《半神 DEMIGOD》，这是和《纽沃斯英雄》、《英雄联盟》等作品并列的“独立化DOTA-like”的尝试之一，DEMIGOD很大胆的采用了全3D场景的逻辑，它这个设计范式后来可能影响了《神之浩劫 SMITE》。
而地牢围攻的故事还有个后续。《地牢围攻3》不是GPG做的，而是被交给了——Obsidian，对，就是黑曜石。《地牢围攻3》和《阿尔法协议》、《无冬之夜2》、《旧共和国武士2》啥的一起，算是黑曜石早期作品的代表。其实我个人感觉《地牢围攻3》做的挺烂的，玩着不高兴，它的手柄互动做的很笨拙。
但《地牢围攻3》团队还有几个人，很神奇的可以串起来“后魔兽世界时代”的很多作品。比如《地牢围攻3》的项目总监Richard Taylor，他是黑岛末期加入的团队，事实上就在入职的同一年就一起进入了黑曜石。做完地牢围攻3以后，他去暴雪担任副制作总监。这个时间点应该就是《魔兽世界》的狂飙突进上升期。
https://image.gcores.com/3f69f75d5c8351ba7c0c7a0d492a63d0-1024-640.png

另外就是《地牢围攻3》的创意总监George Ziets，他出身Westwood，是《Earth & Beyond》的编剧，这个《Earth & Beyond》不是一般玩意儿，虽然聊到Westwood的时候大家都不太提它，在早期MMO里也算是有一号的神奇作品——你大概可以理解为那个时代的EVE Online吧，事实上EA给这个游戏关了的时候，真有一大波人跑去玩EVE Online了，以及现在还有E&B的私服在运作。额外提一句现在我们可能没有概念了，但Westwood如日中天的时候就是这样一家什么玩意儿都会做的公司，不只是RTS。话说回来，这位老哥还参与了《指环王OL LOTRO》和《龙与地下城OL DDO》的制作，这两部MMO虽然在国内网游市场大乱斗的时候败下阵来，但其实它们都有自己的狠活儿，在后魔兽世界设计范式中都留下了自己的一笔，比如DDO独特的副本互动逻辑，还有指环王OL硬朗的叙事能力，这俩游戏现在玩家群体数量都还可以。George Ziets后来去了inXile，参与制作了《废土2》和《苦难：纽蒙拉之潮》，都是CRPG里响当当的响当当，如果你没玩过——总的来说推荐打个汉化补丁玩《废土2》，纽蒙拉之潮就比较难啃了，毕竟纽蒙拉可是《异域镇魂曲》的精神继承作品。
差不多，就是这样。《地牢围攻》系列的团队里大概出了三四个最后跑去做魔兽世界的人，你说这多有意思。
柏亚舟：老游戏确实需要重制
同事闲聊，纳老师说，在环球影城排大队的时候，是最觉得自己需要一个沉迷其中的手游的时候。我说，那你带个掌机啊。导演在旁边说，现在的掌机都续航太短了。
我这才猛然发现，我确实不太说配说这个提议，因为我自己根本不算一个“掌机玩家”，这个痛点我根本不清楚——因为我几乎没有过“把掌机拿起来玩到没电”这种经历。
再往前回忆，我家还真有不少掌机：NDS，3DS，PSP，PSV，好几台NS1，以及NS2。除了NS系列，多少是有点叶公好龙补票，而NS恰恰是最能体现我使用习惯的：我是一个几乎从来不用掌机模式的人，只会用座机模式玩。
这一点我和我爱人刚好相反，她玩着玩着，就想把机器拿起来坐床头玩。她的游戏倾向是床头>客厅>书房电脑，因为对着电脑游戏，用她的话讲“还是像上班”；我的顺序是客厅>书房电脑>任何时候用掌机玩游戏，粗暴总结就是，屏幕越大，我越舒服 —— 这次国庆出差，我研究了半天串流还是决定打包我的PS5随身带，谁让我还是喜欢在PS5上卖游戏。
但又好像不仅仅是屏幕的事儿 —— 我还是一个被腌入味的“现代玩家”，虽然小时候就玩过一些老RPG，但是经过现代驯化之后，很多老游戏我是玩不了的。
还是以我最近玩的空轨系列为例，我打完了两部《空之轨迹》重制，我那个安利我好几年的朋友留下了老母亲式感动热泪的同时，催促我赶紧玩3rd，以及《零之轨迹》和《碧之轨迹》。我说我有PSV，刚好也有这三部游戏，那就开玩。
https://image.gcores.com/d5e5885c9c7275a104eb7e9c98563fe1-800-500.png
结果在经历过重制洗礼之后，小屏幕+黏土小人的游戏体验突然就降低了一截。
我需要克服吗，这两天我也在思考这个问题。万一我玩进去了呢？比如《刺客信条2》，我作为《大革命》《枭雄》入坑的“非系列老玩家”，当年回过头去玩《刺客信条2》真觉得哪里都不好，操作反人类，甚至包括主角艾吉奥也喜欢不起来，我捏着鼻子玩到《兄弟会》和《启示录》，才终于豁然开朗理解了剧情，但你要真问我体验有多好，我只能冒天下之大不韪地说，缺点真不少啊。
后来我又补了中间的几代，包括老《黑旗》，今年有重制《黑旗》的时候，其实我甚至会想，要是我没玩过老黑旗就好了，那个剧情，配合现代的画面和操作习惯，现在的玩家才幸福吧！
连龙舅舅玩了《真三国无双2》重制版之后也感慨，“不要总听人吹老游戏多好多好的”，如果玩这个游戏的经典模式，真的会“一玩一个不吱声”。
但我把一些真实想法告诉老轨迹厨朋友、表示未必能坚持玩完3rd、零和碧时，还是换来了嗤之以鼻：
“和你这种不懂黏土人萌感的没话说！”
所以你们这些厂商还是得重制啊，虽然3rd重制明年好像等不到，因为界2再不出玩家要骂了……虽然重制不是很急，但一定要快啊法老控。
白广大：东疆碎片
国庆去了新疆，路线是乌鲁木齐-吐鲁番-鄯善-哈密。
选择东疆的原因是新疆实在是太大了，北疆与南疆如果没有自驾和很长时间的假期，很难玩得尽兴。
尽管时间并不长，但是整个新疆给我的感受和震撼还是超出了我的想象。
https://image.gcores.com/fb2e20b4456cfaf7fb797c4f7d4632f2-1280-959.JPEG
几乎所有的小孩子都说汉语——而且新疆街上小孩的比例真的很高，甚至远超我在内地城市所感知到的比例。
国际大巴扎熙熙攘攘的人群里，可以看到天南海北的游客以及……很多新疆本地人。连司机都吐槽说：“市场，什么时候都可以一个逛，堵成这样，为什么！新A牌子的，热闹的凑，一家子人，去哪不好的呢！”
司机是哈萨克族，微带馕言，字正腔圆。
https://image.gcores.com/382c9d45cb2bbbc66a1194da6c652220-959-1280.JPEG
https://image.gcores.com/c5414757a1f6703da3a8e9f13596f9d7-1280-959.JPEG
吐鲁番所有的食物都很好吃。我们用一天的时间转了葡萄沟、火焰山和高昌故城，第二天又去了交河。
显然，东疆的出片怪比例并没有赛里木湖和阿勒泰那么高。爽吃葡萄和各种水果的同时，我与夫人一边看着小红书上人头汹涌的北疆实况，一边啧啧称奇。
https://image.gcores.com/52eb32f12d727011f2de739de4ad8749-959-1280.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/5b23822a27ba32726eb4b6c35218b8e8-1280-959.jpg
旁边卖葡萄的阿姨也凑过来一起看着：“啧啧，这么多人。”
阿姨是维族人，我们一起看了会儿视频，她送了我们一些葡萄，还告诉我们去哪里买性价比高的葡萄干。
“吐鲁番的市场，买了都能快递的呢！葡萄的，给你们，拿着！我们吐鲁番的人，不吃葡萄的，看都看饱了！你们下次来，八月，找个葡萄架，站在底下，随便吃！不用桶带走，光吃，不要钱！”
阿姨用雄鹰一样的口音说。
鄯善的沙漠很漂亮。根据本地的朋友说，塔里木当然更好。
“沙漠又有什么可看的？还是大城市好。我们这里，一到假期，人都走光了，都在鸟市！”
哈密本地的瓜的口感远超想象。当地有哈密瓜博物馆，市场里瓜的类型和数量比我一辈子见到的都多，5块钱一盒吃到饱，一根巨大的瓜条只要1元。以及，所有的菜品份量都很大。
https://image.gcores.com/469abc025cb10d0604c3a5f52924d4df-959-1280.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/1dc256da2c7a2566a4a54e11262fc125-959-1280.jpg
最后，感谢@螳螂在后 老师推荐的乌鲁木齐一把手抓饭。是我这辈子吃过最好吃的抓饭和羊腿排。
https://image.gcores.com/e5ca557e2a5ef63b18f3b9e77a7e5318-959-1280.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/12cf133e99f672e0ef70a3742b2afd4b-959-1280.jpg

news.title: 脑洞这么大，不拿个奖可惜了｜ACC × Hyper3D Agent 创作挑战赛招募
news.summary: 想不想做个「我的世界生成器」，让朋友上传一张照片，就能把照片里的东西变成方块风格的 3D 模型，再试着打印出来，摆到桌上？ 你家那只每天推杯子、偷零食的猫，如果当上游戏主角，会不会比你更会玩？ 这些想法，这次可以动手试试

content.v: 想不想做个「我的世界生成器」，让朋友上传一张照片，就能把照片里的东西变成方块风格的 3D 模型，再试着打印出来，摆到桌上？
你家那只每天推杯子、偷零食的猫，如果当上游戏主角，会不会比你更会玩？
这些想法，这次可以动手试试了。
10 月 21 日至 23 日，「Hyper3D 造物实验室｜Agent 创作挑战赛」将在 ACC 2026 举行，前两天每天各招募 50—80 人创作者，并在第三天集中展示与颁奖。
带上一句想法、一张参考图，或者一个已有模型，和 Hyper3D Agent 一起，把它做成能给用的 3D 工具、可分享的3D应用、能玩的 3D 小游戏。现场还有现金、硬件及会员奖励，等你来拿。
个人、团队均可报名，不要求提前提交 Demo。扫描下方海报二维码即可报名。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14512/2222d24e998e230bf8a12732b322eaa8.jpg_mw680water
01｜你的创意，可以长成什么样？
这次挑战有两个方向，前两天各一个主题，任选其一参加。
10 月 22 日，做一个有意思的 3D 工具。
比如，和 Hyper3D Agent 一起做一个「我的世界生成器」。
你可以这样描述它：用户上传一张 2D 图片，就能把图里的主体转换成《我的世界》那样的方块风格 3D 模型，还可以调整配色、旋转查看。
接下来，和 Agent 一起把这个想法做成网页工具：设计图片上传入口，添加调整选项，把生成的模型放进预览窗口。再换几张图片试试，看看哪里需要修改。
也可以尝试做一个「3D Logo 展示台」。让用户上传自己的 Logo，选择立体厚度、材质和背景，从不同角度查看效果，比较哪种搭配更合适。
这一方向要交付的是一个别人也能用的应用工具。用户带着自己的图片或想法来，也能通过你设计的操作流程，生成、调整和预览 3D 作品。
10 月 22 日，做一款让人想上手的 3D 小游戏。
让自家的猫在房间里捣蛋，赶在主人回来前完成任务；把香蕉做成赛车，在迷你赛道上躲避障碍；或者经营一颗小星球，收集资源，让荒地慢慢长出植物。
游戏不用做得很大。一次体验一两分钟，有明确的目标、基本操作，以及胜负或完成反馈，就可以围绕它展开创作。
角色怎么动，玩家要做什么，哪里有趣、哪里卡住，都需要你在制作和试玩中一点点调整。
上面这些只是例子。你有更想做的东西，也欢迎开脑洞。
02｜一个人来，也有一支 3D 团队帮你
做 3D，往往需要不同工种配合：建模师负责造型，绑骨师给角色搭好能够活动的骨架，渲染师处理灯光、材质和画面效果。
和 Hyper3D Agent 合作，就像有了一支这样的 3D 团队。你说出想法，看着结果提修改，再和它一起推进。
从一句描述、一张参考图或一个已有模型开始，你可以通过对话生成和修改图片、3D 模型，再用这些素材制作网页、小游戏和视频。除了调整角色造型、道具配色，你也可以让它帮你搭建应用界面、添加交互，把素材用到具体的作品里。
前两天的创作开始前， 现场各有 15 分钟的 Hyper3D Agent 产品与功能讲解 ，通过具体案例演示制作流程。
工具创作日会介绍图片编辑、3D 模型生成与预览，以及应用制作；游戏创作日会介绍角色与场景、基础交互、玩法修改和试玩。
创作期间，Hyper3D 团队将提供现场答疑。活动也将提供比赛所需的基础产品额度，并在赛前发放入门材料。
你不需要提前把所有步骤都摸透。不过，想做成什么样、哪里需要改，还得由你来判断。
03｜做完以后，让大家来玩
10 月 23 日，集中展示、试玩、评审和颁奖。
前两天做出的工具和游戏，将在这一天交给现场观众和评委体验。
工具的操作是否清楚，别人能不能顺利得到想要的结果；游戏的目标是否好懂，玩家会在哪一步卡住，这些都可以通过现场体验得到反馈。
活动还将安排作品分享，聊聊你的创意从哪来、制作时遇到了什么问题，以及如何通过和 Agent 对话、反复修改，把它做出来。
两个方向的作品统一参评。专家评审团+大众评审团将结合创意、完成度和使用体验，评选前五名，并在现场颁奖。
04｜这次，为你的创作准备了这些奖励
本次活动的奖励包括：
现金奖励共 6,000 元；
实物奖品共 23 件，总价值 36,583 元；
Hyper3D Business 单月会员共 20 份。
现金与实物奖品总价值 42,583 元，另有会员权益。
带着你的工具或游戏来，让评委看看，也让现场的人亲手试试。
05｜熟手欢迎，新人也欢迎
我们欢迎开发者、3D 创作者、设计师、游戏策划，也欢迎有想法、愿意动手的创作新人。
如果你做过游戏、写过程序，或者熟悉建模、设计和 AI 创作工具，可以带着已有经验，试试新的制作方式。
如果你刚开始接触 3D，也可以报名。先想清楚一个小而具体的创意，告诉我们你想做什么、擅长什么，以及用过哪些工具。
报名不要求提前提交本次活动的 Demo。 如果有个人作品、项目或作品集链接，可以附上，帮助我们了解你的创作经历。
个人或已有团队均可报名。希望寻找队友的个人报名者，主办方将协助匹配。
如报名人数超过现场容量，将优先考虑信息完整、能够按活动安排到场，并具备开发、3D 创作或相关技术经验的报名者。
06｜带上电脑，来海淀公园
活动地点 北京·海淀公园
活动安排
10 月 21 日：3D 应用工具创作挑战
10 月 22 日：3D 游戏创作挑战
10 月 23 日：作品展示、公开试玩、评审与颁奖
前两天任选一个创作方向参加，第三天集中展示与颁奖。每日 13:30—14:00 签到，14:00—18:00 正式活动。
招募人数 每天 50—80 人
报名截止 10 月 20 日 23:59
参赛请自带笔记本电脑和充电器，提前用邮箱注册 Hyper3D 账号。可以准备 1—2 个初步创意，以及有权使用的参考图、草图或模型。
扫描上方海报二维码或点击阅读原文，填写报名信息。主办方将在活动前通过活动群发送参赛确认信息、交通指引和准备清单。
海淀公园见！

news.title: 触乐怪话：Make《生化危机》Great Again
news.summary: 触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。 图/小罗 国庆假期的最后一天，我去看了《生化危机：爆发夜》。电影过半，主角布莱恩被狗追进一个谷仓，墙角放着一罐急救喷雾。他看都没看就走了。 后来翻影评的时候，我才知道，

content.v: http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/6ad1c8dd2f9d5.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。
国庆假期的最后一天，我去看了《生化危机：爆发夜》。电影过半，主角布莱恩被狗追进一个谷仓，墙角放着一罐急救喷雾。他看都没看就走了。
后来翻影评的时候，我才知道，布莱恩一路经过急救喷雾和绿色药草，一样都没带上，这就好比你在看一个一命通关挑战的实况，主播已经丝血，但连续错过各种补血道具一样令人恼火。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/9996ad081fdecb56.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
不过，电影毕竟不是游戏，自然不能完全代入游戏当中，但从这些细节中不难发现，《生化危机：爆发夜》绝对是一款比此前的系列作品更靠近游戏的一部电影。
布莱恩是个医疗快递员（也许是？反正可以理解为顶级闪送专员）。他临时接了一单夜班活，因为能拿双倍工资，要把一个包裹送到浣熊市的医院，后面的剧情如果你还没看过，就不再剧透，我打算从游戏叙事与《生化危机：爆发夜》剧情的推进类似之处聊一聊这部电影。
在整部电影中，布莱恩做的事其实和玩家第一次玩《生化危机》时差不多：他会搜房间、浪费子弹，也会打开那扇上帝视角看来绝不应该打开的那扇门。
看这部电影的感觉就好像坐在沙发上看朋友打游戏，就好像感觉自己又玩了一遍《生化危机》，而且旁边还坐着一个和自己一样菜的朋友。
这让我想起米拉·乔沃维奇演的那几部《生化危机》电影。爱丽丝从第一部开始就很能打，后来几部更是一个人对付一群丧尸，打到最后已经有了超级英雄的样子，整部电影极其注重大场面的刻画，就像同时期许多科幻灾难片一样。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/9206ad082156ce6f.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
当然，米拉·乔沃维奇演的这几部电影我看得也挺开心，但其实更像是借着《生化危机》这个IP的世界观和设定，去拍一部超英电影一样。看到后来，我们的情绪已经很难被女主遭受的种种困难所牵动——因为我们知道，他一定能华丽地解决这些困难，并且倒在她应该倒在的地方。
导演扎克·克雷格在电影路演时提到过，他觉得《生化危机》还应该有一部不一样的电影。他说自己喜欢那种慢慢逼近的恐惧：开局只有一把手枪，要数着子弹用，后来换成霰弹枪、机枪，整个世界都想弄死你，你觉得资源不够，又必须想办法活下去。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/2646ad08242a68e9.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
导演没有再讲一遍里昂的故事，电影里能直接对应游戏的东西很少：浣熊市，保护伞公司，一台打字机，还有布莱恩用的霰弹枪子弹的牌子——熟悉游戏的人看到那台打字机，大概都会想到存档，种种游戏元素就像彩蛋一样藏在电影中，让玩家会心一笑。可以说，这种方式在讨好玩家的同时，又没有增加没玩过游戏观众的观影门槛，实属不错。
可以发现，在过去的游戏改编电影中，常常在还原角色上用力：米拉版后来陆续加进了吉尔、艾达王、威斯克，每次公布选角，都会引起一些质疑和争论。比方说2021年那部重启版把一堆经典角色搬上银幕，结果豆瓣评分只有4.6。
这几年口碑不错的改编，似乎都在刻意脱离游戏中的故事线，或者是去游戏化，比方说亚马逊拍摄的《辐射》剧集就没有讲述任何一代游戏的主线。第一季导演乔纳森·诺兰加了一些新人物，就好像一部非互动版的《辐射5》一样。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/3706ad08275658aa.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
但我觉得，在某种程度上《生化危机：爆发夜》才达到了那种细致入微的游戏体验感，并且做得更加极致（除了主角和NPC有时蠢得令人恼火，但转念想想，我们在游戏中不也经常犯蠢吗？）。
目前，《生化危机：爆发夜》在内地上映一周多，票房已经超过2亿元，豆瓣开分7.2，烂番茄新鲜度96%，是近期评分最高的游戏改编电影。
我不确定导演的这种拍法能否复制到续集或者其他系列，这种让观众“着急”的叙事方式，放在《生化危机》里反而很合适，玩过这个系列的玩家应该早就习惯了狼狈。
但无论如何，这部电影塑造的氛围还是值得去电影院体验一番的，比起《奥德赛》《沙丘》这样不去IMAX影厅可惜了的鸿篇巨著，《生化危机：爆发夜》在小影厅也能够低成本的感受到它的魅力（如果是杜比全景声就更好了，顺带一提，电影的配乐做得不错）。
无论如何，相信你在看完这部电影后，多少能找到一些当初玩《生化危机》游戏时的感受。

content.v: 在《GTA6》的制作过程中，Rockstar的几位负责人曾反复讨论一个问题：玩家去便利店买啤酒，究竟应该怎么把它买到手？
举个例子，按一下按钮就让酒瓶出现在角色手里当然最方便，但当画面和周围的一切都越来越逼真时，凭空出现的酒瓶又显得有些突兀。
那么，就走到冰柜前拿出啤酒，再到柜台付款？可如果每次购物都要完整走一遍流程，玩家会不会很快厌烦？
这也是《GTA6》开发过过程中一直尝试回答的问题： 这个世界究竟要真实到什么程度。
10月14日，彭博社刊出了游戏产业记者杰森·施赖尔（Jason Schreier）关于《GTA6》制作过程的长篇报道。今年9月下旬，他前往位于爱丁堡的Rockstar North，与多位核心负责人进行了一整天的采访，这家惯于保密的公司罕见地详细谈起了《GTA6》开发中走过的弯路。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14511/65eef4a1010603173d4efa424c14181f.appmsg_mw680water
《彭博商业周刊》2026年11月刊封面
对于关注海外3A游戏的玩家来说，应该不会对杰森·施赖尔这个名字应该不会陌生，他曾是Kotaku记者，后来加入彭博社，长期报道游戏产业并与大量开发者有着深度联系，著有《像素工厂》《重置》以及记录暴雪公司兴衰的《Play Nice》等作品。
2018年，他就曾调查Rockstar的加班文化，而这次的报道既包含管理层的讲述，也结合了他过去几年与数十名员工的交流。
这篇报道中《GTA6》的制作周期是八年多。期间，Rockstar经历了关键人物离职、领导结构调整、疫情、泄密和劳资争议， 员工总数也从2018年的2441人增加到截至2026年8月的4711人 ，接近翻倍。为了把这款游戏做出来，Rockstar还得重新学习如何管理一家如此庞大的公司。
一个不断扩大的项目
如果把前期调研也算上，《GTA6》的历史还要更长。2015年，开发负责人罗布·尼尔森（Rob Nelson）和其他几位高层就前往迈阿密进行了调研，当时的项目代号是“Project Americas”——没错，游戏最初设想的地图甚至涵盖北美和南美的大片区域，后来发现野心太大无法实现才缩小到以迈阿密及其周边为原型的地区。
Rockstar原本希望让《GTA6》与《荒野大镖客2》并行开发，后者主要由Rockstar的圣迭戈办公室牵头。然而随着《荒野大镖客2》的规模不断扩大，最终需要调动公司大部分人手，包括高级管理团队，尼尔森意识到必须先集中力量完成这款游戏才能继续其他，《GTA6》因此往后推了几年。这也带来了一些好处，比如为《荒野大镖客2》建立的技术和系统后来也能用到新作上。
《GTA6》的开发也改变了Rockstar的生产方式：过去，各地的办公室可以同时推进多款游戏；如今， 公司大部分员工则集中投入同一个项目 。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14511/be758ff716d82fbe94ff85f7863b9048.appmsg_mw680water
位于爱丁堡的Rockstar North
《荒野大镖客2》之后，多名重要员工离开，包括长期担任主要编剧的联合创始人丹·豪瑟（Dan Houser）。尼尔森的职责随之扩大，他与菲尔·胡克（Phil Hooker）、亚伦·加布特（Aaron Garbut）共同担任开发负责人。三人在采访中表示，日常工作与过去没有太大不同，仍是带领各自的团队并填补项目中的空缺，但部分员工抱怨参与决策的人太多，意见时常反复，有时甚至彼此冲突。
尼尔森知道这些不满，他指出即便只有一位负责人，也同样可能遇到决策迟缓或不断改主意的问题。总之随着管理人员的交接和项目的扩张，团队着实经历了一段难以看清方向的日子。
到2019年年底，《GTA6》故事的骨架才基本确定：主角杰森·杜瓦（Jason Duval）和露西娅·卡米诺斯（Lucia Caminos）是一对“雌雄大盗”， 两人将在虚构的迈阿密闯荡。至于游戏应该怎样玩，许多基本问题在当时还没有答案——
它当然要有抢车、枪战和开放世界，但角色与这个世界打交道时，究竟要遵守多少现实生活的规则？前文所说的“买啤酒”讨论，就发生在这一阶段。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14511/2ca3cebde33c964a365da08d4c2a8a46.appmsg_mw680water
《GTA6》的两位主角：露西娅与杰森
随后疫情迫使员工居家办公，动作与表演捕捉工作室完全停工，扩充团队的大规模招聘又增加了内部沟通的难度，再加上一些资深设计师因为迟迟看不到进展而离职，尼尔森将这段时期称为“黑暗时期”。
他能够想象，员工每天面对手上的工作，却始终看不到这些内容拼成一款完整的游戏，难免开始怀疑： 它真的能做出来吗？
直到2022年，团队才积累了足够多的内容，能够隐约看出游戏的全貌。
让城市和人物变得可信
《LOVE》杂志本月刊出的采访，补充了Rockstar如何逐步接近这个目标的细节。
尼尔森介绍，团队以八周为一个阶段，将事先约定的内容整合起来，集中评估，再决定下一阶段该改什么、往哪里推进，这样一个过程持续了多年，最终才完成了一个庞大世界的内容。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14511/8b16c8f86573192f09519a1f9d1c2ced.appmsg_mw680water
《LOVE》杂志的《GTA6》主题封面
漫长的开发周期，也意味着团队需要判断， 今天感兴趣的话题，到了游戏发售时是否仍然值得讨论 。
Rockstar叙事负责人鲁珀特·汉弗莱斯（Rupert Humphries）在《LOVE》的采访中解释，一种只会流行六个月的现象未必值得跟风，他们更关注阴谋论、人们对日常事件作出的奇怪反应，以及那些普遍存在的社会现象，再从中找到自己的角度，创造出经过扭转和放大的版本，让游戏在多年之后问世时，仍然能让玩家感到它与自己所处的时代有关。
贯穿这个系列的“美国梦”，也在这样的观察中发生了变化。 汉弗莱斯认为今天的美国梦或许已经不再是飞黄腾达，而只是让家人有房可住、把贷款还清 ，可即便如此朴素的愿望对普通人来说也可能同样遥不可及；在他看来，迈阿密和佛罗里达南部恰好处在巨大财富与无止境野心交锋的前线，仿佛一个孕育各种疯狂的高压锅。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14511/a5673da46a54c0a2d6e5b14a3d33771e.appmsg_mw680water
迈阿密热火队主场 Kaseya Center 屋顶的《GTA6》宣传装置
双主角的关系也是其中一个耗时多年的难题。既然故事讲的是一对情侣，开发团队就希望他们在开放世界里也能一起生活，比如玩家控制杰森时，可以发短信约露西娅见面，一起散步、牵手，聊起她母亲曾经对他发火的往事；到了健身房两人可以各自锻炼，走出健身房又能一起抢劫商店，在警察追赶时继续拌嘴或调情。
但要让另一位主角在这些互动场景里作出合适的反应，就需要复杂的游戏内AI和大量配套工作。尼尔森承认团队曾经犹豫过，但也有人坚持：这是一款关于情侣的游戏，他们就得像一对情侣那样相处。最终决定把这套系统做下去， 团队就得花上数年逐一解决随之而来的难题 。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14511/845b70983ddbf7b9ad962523ff789322.appmsg_mw680water
露西娅与杰森的餐馆场景
城市里的其他人也要尽量真实，这自然带来了超出预期的工作量。有一次团队估算需要为多少非玩家角色编写内容、制作动画才能达到想要的效果，结果发现现有产能根本不够，尼尔森形容当时的估算结果“令人恐惧”。
Rockstar于是迅速在洛杉矶组建了一间工作室，招入编剧、制作人和导演，专门负责这些角色。汉弗莱斯也在《LOVE》的采访中提到，城市里的行人对白由洛杉矶的专门团队负责，而广告与喜剧写作则汇集了纽约、洛杉矶和伦敦的创作者，这些看似只是背景的声音，同样需要专门的人来创作。
《Dazed》秋季刊的采访提供了一些额外的细节。Rockstar负责角色的高级美术总监杰米·李·劳埃德（Jamie-Lee Lloyd）谈到，团队为了做出更丰富的人群，开发了新的工具与制作流程，而要让这些人物显得可信，外貌、动作、互动和表达就得协调一致，这些工作需要不同团队配合完成。
还有《Game Informer》杂志关于天气的报道，也给出了另一个直观的例子：玩家所在的区域可能没有下雨，却能看见远处的雨区；等开车过去，雨可能已经停了，但地面仍留着积水，这类细节只有在天气、场景与玩家移动连在一起时，才会显出效果。对于一款允许玩家随意走动的开放世界游戏，做好各个部分之后，还得花大量工夫让它们衔接起来。
延期背后的取舍
2023年12月4日，《GTA6》的首支预告片公布时，仍计划在2025年发售。Rockstar的负责人表示，他们当时确实相信能够如期完成，但一线开发人员则更为怀疑。随着期限接近，开发团队最终向发行负责人提出，需要更多的开发时间。
发行负责人詹妮弗·科尔比（Jennifer Kolbe）给母公司Take-Two的首席执行官斯特劳斯·泽尔尼克（Strauss Zelnick）打了电话，先是将发售时间推迟到2026年5月；几个月后她又打了一次电话，要求再延至11月。据她回忆，泽尔尼克听到第二次延期时，第一反应是：“你在开玩笑吧。请告诉我你在开玩笑。”
但在听完解释后，他接受了这个决定。泽尔尼克本人向彭博社表示，如果延期能让作品达到它应有的完成度，多投入时间和资金通常是值得的。
负责人们没有将延期解释为某一次灾难性的技术失败，许多部分只是没有按照预期的速度完成，直到开发后期设计也仍在调整。
制作方式上的调整同样需要时间，因为Rockstar希望 减少对长期加班的依赖 。2018年《荒野大镖客2》发售前，一些员工曾连续数月每周工作60小时，管理层当时就决定不能再按这种方式完成下一款游戏。这就意味着要招更多人，重新估算任务所需的时间，更严格地安排工作、追踪进度，并为额外工作提供补休，部分情况下还有额外报酬。
即便如此，加班也并没有消失，但施赖尔过去几年采访的数十名Rockstar员工，大多认可公司在减少过度加班、解决部分管理者作风苛刻或难以共事的问题等方面作出的改变。
但与此同时，新的矛盾也在出现。2022年9月，一次针对公司Slack的钓鱼攻击，导致数十段尚未完成的《GTA6》开发视频外泄。加布特形容，看着本来不该被人看见的早期作品流到网上，有一种私密空间被闯入的感觉。到2024年，Rockstar以安全为由要求员工每周五天到办公室工作，并禁止员工在办公室之外访问公司的服务器和工具。这项政策引发了很大争议，尤其是2026年8月又发生了一次重大泄密之后。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14511/3e272f2824b078817ae556d6f4bc65df.appmsg_mw680water
Rockstar North办公楼中庭
两个小时的意外旅程
这些变化是《GTA6》漫长制作过程的一部分，Rockstar一边尝试调整完成游戏的方式，一边面对员工对公司的不同期待。随着开发进入后期，游戏也逐渐成形，胡克向施赖尔回忆，其中一次内部评审曾让团队受到很大鼓舞。他本来要去检查一项主线任务，途中撞到另一辆车，对方司机撞了回来，还大声叫骂。两人停车理论后，他的角色血量偏低，于是走向附近的便利店想找点东西恢复。
此时路上又有一个路人挑衅，双方发生冲突。进店后他发现收银台没人，索性顺手抢了钱。接下来他遭到警察追赶，弃车逃跑后又开始寻找新车，找到一辆值钱的车准备开去卖掉，却差点被另一辆放着吵闹音乐的车撞上。胡克决定跟过去，发现了一处院落，又找到一批可以偷走的东西。等他把赃物卖给销赃人，对方又给了他一条新的线索。
两个小时过去，他仍然没有抵达原本要检查的主线任务。但让他印象深刻的是，评审结束时，参与的人都受到了鼓舞：那些分别制作、反复调整的内容， 终于能够连成一段让人停不下来的游玩经历 。
到了这个时候，制作前期的一些选择才真正显出了价值，情侣之间的闲聊、路人的反应、街边的小店，以及一次事故引发的连锁反应，都能让玩家临时改变主意。而要做到这一点，背后是开发团队花费大量时间解决那些玩家玩得顺畅时根本不会注意到的问题。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14511/1bfc6143612c7378ebd3f13233e2dc42.appmsg_mw680water
《GTA6》中的城市街景

news.title: MLBB十周年：什么是真正的全球化？
news.summary: 10月9日至11日，《决胜巅峰》（Mobile Legends: Bang Bang，下文简称MLBB）十周年庆典在全球十国同步展开。庆典的主题叫“All In MLBB”，活动地横跨亚、欧、美三大洲。在这段时间，你能在

content.v: 10月9日至11日，《决胜巅峰》（Mobile Legends: Bang Bang，下文简称MLBB）十周年庆典在全球十国同步展开。庆典的主题叫“All In MLBB”，活动地横跨亚、欧、美三大洲。在这段时间，你能在印度尼西亚、土耳其看到MLBB的经典元素出现在街头，也能在泰国曼谷看到一座巨型生日蛋糕；你能在马来西亚的演出上看到MLBB的133位Coser，也能在俄罗斯看到开发者在大屏前和玩家之间进行交流。
在现场最直观的是人流，人总是多得不得了，有些地方的热闹程度甚至接近一场小型演唱会。然后是一种强烈的区域特色：翻看与MLBB庆典相关的社交媒体讨论，你会看到语言、肤色、面貌各不相同的玩家，甚至各种不同的民俗元素……这种感觉非常奇妙，一款中国公司做的游戏，如此自然地走入不同国家民众的日常生活。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/7336ad19e8830e59.PNG?imageView2/2/w/700
我们通常会在某种情况下先知道一款游戏很有名，然后才切身体会到它到底有名到什么程度，以及为什么有名。MLBB在大部分情况下属于前者，很多人知道它很有名，但很少有人真正意识到这些话代表着什么，以及MLBB如今成长到的规模。它的成功也早已不止在某个国家、甚至某个大洲。
MLBB由沐瞳科技研发，在海外上线的时间是2016年，在上线10年后的今天，这款游戏的累计注册用户超过15亿、月活超1.1亿。它拥有庞大的玩家群体，覆盖220多个国家和地区。就像庆典上传递的那些感受一样，现在，在全球许多国家，MLBB都是当地玩家最喜欢的国民级游戏，它比许多宣传“全球化”的游戏更全球。
MLBB是怎么做到这一切的？
在谈到MLBB的成功时，我会首先想到它的本土英雄和本地化内容。MLBB中有世界各地充满地域特色的文化内容，这些内容在很多时候是由官方和玩家共同打造的——如果我是一位玩家，我最希望的肯定是开发者能够把我所在的本土文化以重视、有意义的方式做进我喜欢的游戏中，而MLBB在这一点上的尝试相当之早。
在最早期，MLBB并不是一款带有强烈文化色彩的产品。但在上线不久后，开发团队就开始有意识地打造以不同国家文化为核心的游戏内容。2017年5月23日，MLBB中第一位菲律宾本土英雄Lapu-Lapu上线，他的原型是1521年麦克坦之战抵抗西班牙殖民的民族英雄，诞生来自于菲律宾玩家的票选。在此前，电子游戏里几乎没有明确的、来自菲律宾的代表角色，你可以想象当时的菲律宾玩家对这名英雄的感情。

这是一个教科书一样的本土化方式。当玩家们在游戏中看到熟悉的、喜欢的本土内容，他们自然会对这款游戏产生一些更深的感情。但对2017年的MLBB团队来说，他们并没有太多的经验可以参照，很多信息和想法都只能在摸索中尝试——比如“金刚神”Gatotkaca，他的诞生来自多轮在印尼的用研和市场调研。在调研中，团队成员发现，印尼玩家其实玩过很多不同文化背景的游戏，但几乎没有厂商专门为他们做过带有印尼文化元素的游戏。与此同时，他们又注意到，“印尼人恰恰对自己的本土文化非常骄傲”，由此，为印尼用户做金刚神英雄的想法诞生了。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/7976ad1a37366852.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“不同国家在语言、宗教、经济发展阶段和文化习惯上都有差异，所以单纯依靠宏观数据是不够的。”MLBB的产品团队成员格兰杰对我说，“我们会通过当地员工、玩家和社区去倾听更具体的需求，也会结合当地节日、文化和社会习惯来理解用户为什么喜欢某种内容。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/5016ad19f18154b0.png?imageView2/2/w/700
本地英雄是最直观的本地化展现之一，除此之外，还有很多本地化运营上的策略会以更加润物无声的方式呈现——近两年的土耳其市场也是一个例子。MLBB的运营成员告诉我，他们非常重视不同地区用户的文化规律和生活节奏，也会根据当地节日假期安排、内容消费高峰来制定自己的运营体系。

“土耳其的暑假时间非常长，通常持续近三个月。这对于MLBB的内容规划提出了更高要求，我们需要为用户提供足够丰富的内容储备，以支撑他们在这段时间内持续的游戏体验和内容消耗。”格兰杰说，“所以我们针对土耳其市场进行定制化内容规划。一方面，在游戏版本上确保内容的充沛和节奏的连贯性，维持用户持续参与动力；另一方面，在端外围绕玩家喜好和兴趣点提供大量适合当地玩家消费的素材，让游戏内容渗透至玩家每一个日常消费场景。”
这是一个随着业务发展而逐渐认识市场的过程。在最早期，海外团队和当地agency会为团队提供很多市场信息和建议；随着业务发展，沐瞳在各个国家建立了更多分公司和本地团队，也有员工长期派驻当地；再之后，这些团队不只是执行运营工作，也逐渐参与到市场判断、产品策略和方向制定中。我们现在看到的大部分MLBB的本地化内容，都可以说是来自本地文化观察、用户需求和当地团队共同作用的结果。
大部分MLBB的早期运营成员都会对我提到MLBB在早期阶段DAU（日活跃用户数）突破100万的时刻——从外部的视角来说，这是这款游戏在全球上线后飞快达成，又很快被自己远远甩开的目标，甚至有些不值一提。但在2016年，包括MLBB自己的员工在内，大家都没想到这款产品会取得如此巨大的成功。
“刚上线的时候，我们觉得如果能做到 100 万 DAU 就已经很好了。所以我们把这个作为团队当时的目标。”一位MLBB运营成员告诉触乐，“但产品上线后自然增长非常快，自然流量一度占到70%～80%，用户留存也很好。所以我们很快把游戏的长期目标提高到了1000万DAU，结果没想到第二年还没到年底就实现了，大家都非常振奋。”
团队成员告诉我，那几年他们一直处在不断被用户和市场“推着往前走”的状态，很多时候都在刷新自己的预期。比如在发行之初，MLBB是面向全球去做的，也并没有圈定重点市场，是市场表现帮MLBB做出了筛选——早期，团队其实对韩国和巴西市场有过比较高的期待，因为这两个国家本身有成熟的游戏文化和MOBA用户基础，但从实际表现来说，反而是东南亚地区一些相对新兴的市场，在后来成为了MLBB最重要的增长市场。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/2416ad1a1fa67074.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“我们发现，市场成熟并不一定意味着产品更容易成功。一个市场过去有没有 MOBA 传统固然重要，但更重要的是产品能不能解决当地用户真实的使用问题，比如手机性能、网络延迟、语言和社交体验。甚至，越是新兴的市场，越有可能因为移动互联网和移动游戏的发展，形成新的用户习惯。”运营团队成员尤利恩告诉我。
这是一种持续的、连贯的变化。在最开始，海外的数据表现让MLBB团队看到趋势，玩家和社区反馈帮助他们理解需求，在建立当地团队后，他们开始真正理解这些需求背后的文化原因，以及对海外市场建立新的认知和判断。而现在，他们依然在持续关注不同市场的变化，不断探索新的增长空间。
“对我们来说，这不仅仅是市场规模的拓展，更重要的是不断去理解不同国家和区域的玩家，让MLBB的全球化进一步深入。”尤利恩说，“不同市场的差异是很大的。比如土耳其，这里具备相对成熟的PC端游戏文化基础。当地的网吧覆盖率非常高，许多用户从小就习惯在PC平台上进行深度游戏体验，对MOBA类游戏有较高的接受度和参与度，对竞技性和操作性的要求也相对较高。”
“所以我们结合当地用户的游戏习惯制定了拓盘策略，包括优化移动端技能释放逻辑、镜头灵敏度等战斗细节，缩小与PC 端的操作体验差距。”尤利恩告诉我，这一策略也在土耳其市场取得了成效。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/1376ad1a1d25dbd8.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
我想可能最重要的一点是“尊重客观事实”——不同的国家和地区有不同的风土人情，亚洲国家、非洲国家、欧美国家、发展中国家、发达国家——想用一整套规则满足所有的市场是很难的，对于一个来自非文化霸权国的产品来说就更难。在这个前提下，在不同的地方了解当地的玩家，尊重当地的玩家，然后满足当地的玩家，可能这才是最有效的方法论，它不仅对国内玩家有效，对东南亚国家的玩家也有效，对世界任何一个地方的玩家都有效。
我们还可以聊一聊电竞。某种程度上，电竞是MLBB全球化发展的另一条主线。不久前的9月29日到10月1日，第20届亚运会将MLBB列为正式竞技项目，共有来自亚洲11个国家和地区的代表队通过区域预选赛参赛。而从更广的范围看，MLBB今年已经连续四届成为东南亚运动会的正式比赛项目。
在今年年初的M7总决赛现场上，MLBB官宣了M8赛事的举办地将在土耳其，这是M赛有史以来第一次走出亚洲。在总决赛现场，沐瞳表示，未来MLBB将在美洲、东亚、东欧中亚、欧洲中东北非、及东南亚五大全新赛区巡回办赛。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/5366ad1a0a847c39.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
MLBB的职业电竞布局相当早。在2017年，东南亚地区的MLBB赛事体系已经开始建立，在印尼、菲律宾、马来西亚这些地区，几乎所有玩家都会把MLBB的世界赛当作国家级赛事来看，这些地区也为职业联赛输送了大量成绩出色的职业队伍与选手。
与此同时，MLBB的职业电竞布局也在与这款游戏的全球化一起成长。2021年，MLBB在巴西推出职业联赛（MPL Brazil），这是MLBB第一个落地东南亚以外的MPL联赛。到2024年， MPL Brazil、拉美北部超级联赛MLSL North、拉美南部超级联赛MLSL South被整合为统一的拉美职业联赛（MPL LATAM），覆盖巴西、阿根廷、智利、秘鲁、乌拉圭等整个拉丁美洲。
MLBB的职业电竞布局是一套分层的全球体系。在中东北非赛区，当地拥有独立联盟化MPL MENA联赛，与沙特文旅项目达成长期合作。在土耳其，本土MTC冠军赛决出的冠军将获得M世界赛的参赛资格。除此之外，欧洲、中亚区域依托SPL洲际联赛，同样在缩小区域间队伍之间的差距。
在今年1月25日，M7世界总决赛在印尼首都雅加达举行，这场赛事的收视峰值在决赛当晚突破568万，是全球电竞史上观看量第四高的赛事，同时刷新了史上观看量最高的移动电竞赛事的纪录。你可以从这个数字看出MLBB赛事的意义。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/3636ad1a173268eb.png?imageView2/2/w/700

之前，MLBB的赛事团队成员米娅告诉我，在MLBB覆盖的220多个国家和地区、月活跃用户超过1.1亿的更大范围内，许多市场的玩家对游戏的情感联结更多体现在日常生活和文化层面，而非竞技荣誉层面。但他们对这一点并不担心。就像MLBB团队在此前一直说的那样，他们所追求的并不是通过自身的用户基数和影响力来引领某种潮流，打造某种固定的形式。他们更希望的是在更深入地理解本地后，通过长期的投入，让各个地区建设起适合自己的道路。这同样是一种“本地化”与全球化的视野和平台能力的集合。
现在，MLBB已经从东南亚走向了整个世界，并且把许多可复制的经验带到更多地方。比如不久前，团队把去年大获成功的活动“Golden Month”推进到了欧洲和美洲——这个内容包括与本地KOL、创作者合作，通过公益行动回馈社会，以及向全球多个国家和地区送出智能手机。你可以从这些活动的具体内容中看到MLBB的目的：包容全球文化，深化本地化运营，以及和全球的游戏玩家共同庆祝一个与MLBB有关的节日时刻。
再比如8月刚刚落幕的MLBB“2026全球皮肤设计挑战赛”。这场设计比赛面向全球的玩家进行征集与评审，共吸引了来自超过20个国家和地区的1300余名创作者报名，有效参赛作品500余件，你很难想象任何一款其他游戏的二创比赛能在参与者的丰富上达到这种程度。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/7326ad19fea64232.png?imageView2/2/w/700
在这次十周年活动中，我也总是会有这样的感觉：似乎不管任何地方都有MLBB的玩家，而任何玩家谈起MLBB都无比亲切自然，在很多国家和地区，很多玩家不知道、也不在乎MLBB来自哪里，他们唯一在意的是他们喜欢这个游戏。在土耳其站，官方在博斯普鲁斯海峡打造了一艘MLBB专属轮船，欧亚大桥与MLBB十周年标识身处同一画面，这证明了它在东欧及土耳其市场的影响力。在秘鲁，玩家们对游戏写下的留言贴满了整面墙壁。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/4596ad1a01e412f7.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
这也让我意识到另一个问题，当一款全球化的游戏在某些地区的“本土化”发展到某种程度，它的价值、它承担的责任也在随之变化。这些游戏内容在很多时候不仅仅服务于特定地区的玩家，与之对应的是，也并不是“在某个地区推出本土英雄，对应的玩家数据就会有大幅度的增长”，而一个耦合的过程——现在，当玩家想到MLBB的时候，他们想到与这款游戏息息相关的价值不仅关于自己的快乐，还有把自己的文化传递到全球，让自己被看到。
一位菲律宾玩家告诉我，对很多菲律宾人来说，MLBB不只是娱乐，它为当地民众创造了生计，成就了职业道路，也给了他们被看见的平台，“每当菲律宾战队在国际赛场上出战并获胜时，它也给我们整个国家带来了自豪的时刻。”另一位印尼玩家则对我说，MLBB在印度尼西亚是最受年轻人欢迎的游戏，“你会看到有人坐在摩托车上玩，在街边的地上玩，在商场里玩，在各种各样的地方随时开一局”。
“其实在沐瞳的发行实践中，我们一直认为全球化与本地化是彼此成就的。单纯的本地化，其实造就不了一款国民游戏，真正的国民游戏，往往是全球化和本地化共同作用的结果。”格兰杰说。
在MLBB团队成员看来，“全球化审美”本身就意味着对“区域文化特色”的包容、欣赏和融合。一款游戏要成为某个地方的国民游戏，光靠本地化是不够的，它还得有全球化的视野和平台能力，让当地人觉得“这是我们自己的东西，同时它也被全世界看见和认可”。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-16/5526ad1a193c5daf.PNG?imageView2/2/w/700
当一款游戏在10年之后还历久弥坚，并且仍然在活力十足地覆盖全球市场的时候，很显然我们会在它的身上看到更多东西：比如对用户和市场逐渐加深的理解，比如与时俱进的玩法和设计，再比如开发者们清晰坚定的方向感和长远的规划，对“全球化”与“本地化”深入而切实的理解。

MLBB就是这样的游戏。在我看来，它的全球化更贴合现实，成就也更大。那些主流视野之外的地方也有无数的玩家，他们也和世界上所有人一样有自己的快乐和热爱。无论是过去还是未来，MLBB在走向一个国家或地区的思路一直是一种最踏实而朴素的方法，那就是切身关注不同国家和区域用户对游戏的真实体验，真正尊重当地用户，尊重他们的习俗和文化，并在这个基础上解决他们在过程中遇到的具体困难和实际问题在用户的反馈和实际体验中持续地学习。它在几乎没有先例参考的条件下，走出了属于自己的一条路。
对于MLBB来说，不断理解用户、修正认知、再把产品做得更贴近当地用户，既是它在最开始探索出的方法，也是它到现在所习惯承担的责任和追求。它在某些地区真正成为了当地流行文化的一部分，也在某些时刻承载了更大的意义和价值，而且，我也相信，在未来的10年，它会走向更广阔的世界，以一个“全球化平台”的身份做到更多，它会做到这一点的。

news.title: 韩援已经把现在的漫展互动进化到嘴对嘴了吗？
news.summary: 韩援已经把现在的漫展互动进化到嘴对嘴了吗？

content.v: 如今办漫展、搞Cosplay线下活动，主办方最头疼的两件事无非是：票卖不动，热度起不来。于是，邀请知名Coser来撑场子，就成了行业标配。
而在这些Coser当中，Yasal绝对是一个特别的存在。
大多数 人第一次听说她，是在2025年的BW漫展上。
当时她受《棕色尘埃2》游戏厂商的邀请，Cos成白日梦兔女郎·墨菲亚出席活动。
至于角色还原度到底有多高呢?
就这么说吧，她Cos的兔女郎·墨菲亚就像是从游戏里抠出来的。那腰臀比，绝对是逆天的存在。
但真正让Yasal出圈的，并不是这身封神的装造，而是她那堪比教科书级的营业态度——不管你是游戏死忠老粉，还是纯粹凑热闹路过的路人，在她这儿都一视同仁。
在合影环节，Yasal不仅会主动跟着镜头切换姿势、调整表情，还会和抽到合影资格的幸运粉丝进行亲密互动。
甚至，就连看台侧面的吃瓜群众，都被她精准捕捉，顺手甩来一波饭撒。
就这样，在一众敷衍式营业的同行衬托下，Yasal很快就成为了BW里的焦点之一。
然而，敬业是要付出代价的。
到了第二天，Yasal就被人举报进了小黑屋。再露面时，她的兔女郎战袍已经换成了平平无奇的工作人员制服
不过，即使是这样，粉丝的热情也依旧不减，甚至队伍比之前还长了三倍。
光从这一点就能看出，Yasal有多受阿宅们的喜爱了。
而这位话题性拉满的韩援顶流Coser，最近又因为签售现场上演的“超纲操作”，再度引爆了整个二次元圈。
事情是这样的：
就在前两天，有网友在社交媒体分享了一段参加线下签售会的视频。
画面里，Yasal穿着《碧蓝航线》大凤（鹩）的Cos服，亲笔给粉丝写下祝福语。接下来，意想不到的事情出现了。
只见她一把搂住粉丝，和对方来了个亲密Kiss（注意：不是一下，而是三下）。
值得一提的是，Yasal的这场活动属于付费的一对一私签。
所以在尺度方面，大家懂的都懂。
不过，尽管早有准备，但这种“嘴对嘴”的神奇操作，还是把围观群众的CPU给干烧了。
因此，这条帖子发出来没多久后，网上瞬间就炸开了锅。
有网友暗自懊悔被亲的不是自己;也有网友理性表示这样的互动一点也不卫生;还有网友忙着在网上打听价格……
然而，当吃瓜群众还在激情讨论的时候，当事人Yasal已经闪现到“事故现场”，做出了官方澄清。
原来，视频里那位黑衣短发的“小哥”是一位打扮偏中性的女粉。至于亲吻，也不是她临时起意的，而是这位粉丝主动提出的。
要说整件事唯一没按剧本走的，那就是原本说好的亲脸，被她临时换成了嘴对嘴。
男粉丝：哦，原来是女生吗?那我现在学伪音、扮男娘也可以吗?
事实上，这并不是Yasal第一次在签售会上做出这样的亲密举动了。
早在之前，网上就流传过她和其他女粉十指相扣亲吻的照片。
虽然当时也有零星争议，但却完全没有发酵到如今这种全网热议的程度。
同一套操作，为什么热度差距会这么大呢?
核心原因就一个：视觉陷阱。
由于这次漫展里的另一个主人公打扮的过于中性，以至于不少围观网友在看到视频的时候，都以为她是男性粉丝。而这，也就放大了事件的冲击感。
不过，虽说同性之间的亲吻互动要比异性听起来更好接受一点。
但也有不少网友认为，这样的营业方式实在是有点过火了。
正如上文所说，Yasal 这次参加的签售会是一对一的私人签售。
粉丝花了钱，Coser满足愿望——双方一个愿打一个愿挨。按理说，咱们这些旁观者确实没什么立场去审判。
但舆论依旧吵得不可开交，而大家争论的核心其实就一个： 漫展、签售会这些场合的互动边界，究竟该划在什么地方?
早些年签售会上，粉丝和Coser的互动就是签个名、合个照、聊聊天，顶多就是再拉拉手。
可现在，大家互动的方式越来越“卷”，像比心、贴脸、拥抱这些略显亲密的互动，也渐渐从“惊喜彩蛋”变成了默认套餐。
不过，以上这些行为还都在合理范围内，可以用“营业尺度”来自洽。
真正让人后背发凉的，是已经有人把线踩得更低了。
前段时间，有位出蕾姆的Coser，在漫展上推出了一个付费项目：只要花钱，就能把头埋在她的胸口。
除此之外，还有背部按摩、用脚踩背这些离谱的项目……
然而，还只是漫展乱象中的冰山一角。
这几年，Cos圈里的那条线在一点点地往下走。
虽然目前“亲嘴”互动还只是个例，但Cos圈最怕的就是先例变惯例——当一个Coser做出新标准之后，难保不会有人照着抄。甚至，还有可能将标准一拉再拉。

news.title: 《ROLL一下勇士》试玩报告：战棋？不，是符文赌场
news.summary: 把阵型、肉鸽和骰子技能搅成一锅，玩起来像在棋盘上开赌场！这款Demo堪称肉鸽赌鬼的天选之子！

content.v: 骰子、肉鸽、 策略 ，当这三个词摆在一起的时候，对我这种肉鸽爱好者，十级赌徒选手而言，吸引力是莫大的。因此当看到由Stove Studio推出的这款Demo时，我毫不犹豫选择了尝尝咸淡。
总体来说，《ROLL一下勇士》目前给我的试玩体验，可以用一句话来概括：长板很长，短板也很短。
这款游戏真正做到了把阵型、肉鸽和骰子技能搅成一锅，玩起来像在棋盘上开赌场：每一步都要算，但每一手都得看命。什么叫要算又看命呢?就是它并不能单纯依靠构筑轻松胜利，也不能单纯依靠运气一飞冲天。
玩法非常简单，在游戏的开始玩家要从民兵、守卫、猎人、学徒以及通关第一章解锁的牧师这五种职业中，选择三个开始自己的 冒险 之旅。随着游戏进度的推进，每次冒险中玩家最多可以拥有六个可操作的角色，通过选择角色升级方向、调整装备以及站位安排的方式，努力抵达终点。
游戏最核心的便是战斗系统，虽然叫《ROLL一下勇士》，这里的骰子却不是用来判定的。每个角色有独立骰池，不同职业的符文比例和点数分配都不一样，每回合摇出的符文就是你的战术预算，剑、盾、法杖、星星四种符文往池子里一扔，你能砍、能扛、能放法，还是只能干瞪眼，全看这一把。
因此战斗的核心不是“点数大不大”，而是“资源怎么花”。每个角色Roll出来的结果会被纳入公共资源池，使用技能不消耗公共资源，但是随着等级的提升，越强大的技能所需要的点数就越多，种类也越丰富。倘若公共资源不能满足技能需求，即便构筑的战队非常强大，也没用。
不过如果实在无法接受这一回合的倒霉，可以在单次遭遇战结束之前，选择重新开始本次战斗。
角色培养方面，每个职业都有丰富的进化方向，每次升级都会强化骰子池与技能，还能解锁一些特殊效果，比如站在中列可以为队友带来加成，根据不同职业方向的选择，以及角色强化路径调整站位分配，是游戏最大的吸引点。因为在你足够了解角色后，从进入游戏的第一时间，你的构筑就已经开始了，判断阵型与选择合适的敌人，都能让策略性高度发挥。
游戏采用关卡制战斗，地图上选前进方向，有敌人、奖励和商店格，末尾关底BOSS，击败通关便可进入下一关，在目前的试玩版中只开放到第四关。难度梯度的问题是目前游戏的短板之一，前几关教学友好，能比较快理解符文和阵型逻辑，但第四关的难度明显增加，失败要从第一关重来，还没有什么奖励机制，导致肉鸽惩罚感偏重。
有时候我刚觉得自己彻底悟了，阵营成型了，结果Roll不出全技能，一失误回解放前，不管是彻底重开还是单场遭遇战的重来，耐心总容易跟着骰子一起摇没。加上Demo版中还有很多地图事件没有开放，商店中也有未解锁的板块，导致观感上来说，地图随机事件和商店格内容偏薄，奖励多样性也还有提升空间。
总体来说，在Demo版有限的体验内容中，我对这款游戏的完整版还是较为期待的。现在看起来策略池并没有想象中深，以及正向反馈的塑造有些欠缺，但这并没有掩盖它玩法上的趣味性。
它把“随机”做成了策略的一部分，而不是策略的敌人。很多肉鸽游戏里，运气不好等于这局白给;但《ROLL一下勇士》里，Roll得烂，你得想办法用烂牌打出不烂的操作。公共资源池就那么多，所以升级的时候选择怎样的技能配置，骰子均衡性怎么安排，都让我对其产生了相当浓厚的探索欲。
如果你既是战棋爱好者，又是肉鸽赌狗，还恰好享受“在随机里找最优解”的烧脑快感，这款Demo绝对值得你体验。
